ds:331:641:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]*cough* I may have uh… been in the area… Unnoticed… many times…
ds:331:641:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]*콜록* 내가, 어… 그 근처에… 눈에 띄지 않게… 여러 번 있었을지도…

ds:331:642:Dialogue Text.source: Wha! Are you peeping on critters?

ds:331:644:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Hey! I’m small! I can’t help if the other critters don’t notice me!
ds:331:644:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]저기! 난 작잖아! 다른 친구들이 날 못 보는 걸 어쩌겠어!

ds:331:645:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Especially in their intense throes of passion…

ds:331:649:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]So what are you two gonna do on your date?
ds:331:649:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]그래서 너희 둘은 데이트 때 뭐 할 거야?

ds:331:656:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Can’t wait to stuff my mouth! I’ll be full all night!
ds:331:656:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]얼른 입을 꽉 채우고 싶네! 밤새 배부르겠어!

ds:331:657:Dialogue Text.source: Indeed! Can’t wait to "eat out" for our picnic!
ds:331:657:Dialogue Text.target: 그렇지! 소풍 가서 ‘밖에서 맛보는’ 게 기대되네!

ds:331:660:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Don’t be fooled Rascal! Mabel isn’t as sweet and innocent as she looks!
ds:331:660:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]속으면 안 돼, 라스칼! 메이블은 겉보기만큼 순하고 순진하지 않아!

ds:331:661:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]She’s been known to peep about on occasions!

ds:331:664:Dialogue Text.source:
Mabel, I hereby give you permission to peep
on any and all sexual activities I’m involved in.
ds:331:664:Dialogue Text.target:
메이블, 이로써 내가 참여하는 모든 성행위를
네가 훔쳐보는 것을 허락하노라.

ds:331:668:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]You must, however, regale all events to Penny Plume. No details shall be left out!
ds:331:668:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]단, 모든 일을 페니 플룸에게 상세히 보고해야 하느니라. 사소한 내용 하나도 빠뜨려선 안 돼!

ds:332:634:Dialogue Text.source: She was all tied up, gaping after this crazy messy pull out!
ds:332:634:Dialogue Text.target: 페니는 묶인 채였는데, 엄청나게 흥건하게 빼고 나니 구멍이 벌어져 있었어!

ds:332:635:Dialogue Text.source: I was right on her, so I could feel her twitching and squirming as she came.
ds:332:635:Dialogue Text.target: 난 바로 그 위에 있어서, 페니가 싸면서 떨고 몸부림치는 게 느껴졌지.

ds:332:637:Dialogue Text.source: I’m tellin’ ya! I was being tickled!

ds:332:638:Dialogue Text.source: The plant was all slurping on my talons, you’d be giggling too!
ds:332:638:Dialogue Text.target: 그 식물이 내 발톱을 쪽쪽 빨고 있었어. 너라도 웃었을걸!

ds:332:640:Dialogue Text.source: That’s not how I remember it!

ds:332:642:Dialogue Text.source: What about you? I seem to remember some intense shivers of pleasure when those tentacles were twisting around in ya.
ds:332:642:Dialogue Text.target: 너는 어땠는데? 그 촉수들이 네 안에서 비틀릴 때 아주 세게 쾌감에 떨었던 것 같은데.

ds:333:29:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Hmmm yeaah. I think this place will do just fine!

ds:333:31:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Oy mate! Just preparing for the dig!
ds:333:31:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]어이, 친구! 땅을 팔 준비를 하고 있어!

ds:333:32:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]I needed a bit more space, so I got the OK from Scarlett to do it here!
ds:333:32:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]공간이 좀 더 필요해서, 여기서 해도 된다고 스칼렛한테 허락받았지!

ds:333:35:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]You’ll see, check up on me later!
ds:333:35:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]나중에 알게 될 거야. 좀 있다가 다시 와 봐!

ds:334:29:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Just got some finishing touches, and we’ll be good to go!

ds:334:32:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Can’t wait to show ya what I got prepared for this thing!
ds:334:32:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]여기서 하려고 준비한 걸 얼른 보여 주고 싶네!

ds:334:34:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Can’t wait to show ya what I got prepared for this thing!
ds:334:34:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]여기서 하려고 준비한 걸 얼른 보여 주고 싶네!

ds:335:30:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Thanks mate! Just wait till we get to training!

ds:335:32:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Ehhh, I’ll need some time to recuperate. That was a ton of work.
ds:335:32:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]어어, 기운을 좀 차려야겠어. 정말 일이 많았거든.

ds:335:33:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]But as soon as I’m ready, you’ll know!

ds:335:35:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Ehhh, I’ll need some time to recuperate. That was a ton of work.
ds:335:35:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]어어, 기운을 좀 차려야겠어. 정말 일이 많았거든.

ds:335:36:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]But as soon as I’m ready, you’ll know!

ds:336:148:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Whew! Dang Rascal, I couldn’t touch you!
ds:336:148:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]후! 와, 라스칼. 한 번도 못 맞혔어!

ds:336:149:Dialogue Text.source: I suppose I learn from the best!

ds:336:150:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Hah! You’re gonna be great at this! I’ll let you know when I get better routines set up!
ds:336:150:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]하! 너 이거 정말 잘하겠는걸! 더 좋은 훈련을 준비하면 알려 줄게!

ds:336:151:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Hehehe… I’ve got a lot of fun stuff planned…

ds:336:155:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]True, but I usually hit folks a lot more than that!
ds:336:155:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]맞아. 하지만 보통은 그보다 훨씬 많이 맞혀!

ds:336:158:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Oooh, I got ya a few times eh?

ds:336:159:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Think you could do better next time?

ds:336:167:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Rascal, mate, I’ll be honest. That was pathetic!

ds:336:168:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]But hey, you can only go up from here, right?

ds:336:169:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Let’s give it another shot when you’re ready.

ds:336:35:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]I’ve got a fun lil’ routine set up.

ds:336:43:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Perfect, so you should be familiar with how to move your body pretty well, yeah?
ds:336:43:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]완벽해. 그럼 몸 움직이는 법은 꽤 익숙하겠네?

ds:336:44:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Oy! Ya ready to give this a shot?

ds:336:46:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Great! For now I’ve prepared this Practice Routine. Let’s get started!

ds:336:50:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I’m gonna try to PELT YOU with ACORNS!

ds:336:53:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]For this first round, we’ll just see how you fare for 30 seconds!
ds:336:53:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]첫 판은 일단 30초 동안 어떻게 버티는지 볼게!

ds:336:54:Dialogue Text.source: Uhhh, I don’t like the sound of this…

ds:336:55:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Psssh, don’t worry mate, it’ll be fine!

ds:336:56:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Let me know when you’re ready to get started!

ds:337:10:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]I see, well, we just got this order in, so we’ll probably sit this one out.
ds:337:10:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]그렇구나. 그런데 방금 이 주문이 들어와서, 우린 이번엔 빠져야겠네.

ds:337:11:Dialogue Text.source:
There’s no rush!
You guys can join us.
ds:337:11:Dialogue Text.target:
급한 거 아니야!
너희도 같이 가자.

ds:337:13:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]It’s okay Rascal, we can’t exactly all ride Penny anyways. We’ll head over once we’re finished here.
ds:337:13:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]괜찮아, 라스칼. 어차피 우리 모두 페니를 탈 수도 없잖아. 여기 일 끝나면 갈게.

ds:337:15:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=8]Yep. Besides… that place kind of gives me the creeps…

ds:337:19:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Ok, we’ll be sure to catch you two up then!
ds:337:19:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]알았어. 그럼 둘한테도 꼭 무슨 일인지 알려 줄게!

ds:337:3:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=10]Come quick! There’s something going on at the ruins!
ds:337:3:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=10]얼른 와! 유적에서 무슨 일이 일어나고 있어!

ds:337:5:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=8]Whoa, what do you mean? Is something wrong?

ds:337:8:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Augustus just told me to round up all the critters! He seemed very excited.
ds:337:8:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]아우구스투스가 모두 모아 달라고 했어! 아주 신나 보였어.

ds:338:12:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Gosh! What could all this be about?

ds:338:265:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Do check on the other critters… they seem a bit more worried…
ds:338:265:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]다른 친구들도 살펴봐 줘… 좀 더 걱정하는 것 같아…

ds:338:2:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Wow check this out! The symbols are glowing!
ds:338:2:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]와, 이것 좀 봐! 상징들이 빛나고 있어!

ds:338:3:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]No idea what this is about, but I’m pretty excited!

ds:338:5:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Honestly, nothing really happens here too often… So I’m a bit more excited than worried about it…
ds:338:5:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]솔직히 여기선 별일이 자주 없잖아… 그래서 걱정보다는 기대가 좀 더 커…

ds:338:6:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Besides! If anything bad happens, I can just fly away! See ya!
ds:338:6:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]게다가! 나쁜 일이 생기면 그냥 날아가면 되지! 잘 있어!

ds:338:8:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I’m sure nothing bad will come of this… Right?

ds:338:9:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]And if something bad happens… We’ll figure it out together! We’re a scrappy bunch!
ds:338:9:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]혹시 나쁜 일이 생겨도… 함께 해결하면 돼! 우리 꽤 끈질긴 친구들이잖아!

ds:339:11:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]C’mon love, there’s no need to get worked up just yet…
ds:339:11:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]그러지 마, 여보. 아직 그렇게 불안해할 필요는 없어…

ds:339:13:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=8]*Sigh* I’m sorry dear, I’m just on edge… This is very strange…
ds:339:13:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=8]*하아* 미안해, 자기야. 그냥 예민해져서… 정말 이상하잖아…

ds:339:19:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]I know, love. But we’ll be ok…

ds:339:2:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Oh Rascal, I’m glad to see you here. Look at what’s happening!
ds:339:2:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]아, 라스칼. 와 줘서 기뻐. 이게 무슨 일이니!

ds:339:3:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=8]I’ve got a bad feeling about this…

ds:339:8:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Mmm, I don’t mean to snip dear, but I’ve been here my whole life and haven’t seen anything like this.
ds:339:8:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]음, 날카롭게 말하려는 건 아닌데, 자기야. 여기서 평생 살았지만 이런 건 본 적이 없어.

ds:339:9:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]If there was ever a time for concern, this is a pretty good one…
ds:339:9:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]걱정해야 할 때가 있다면, 지금이 딱 그런 때지…

ds:33:22:Dialogue Text.source: … Yeah, definitely not going in there.

ds:340:10:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I hope we didn’t do anything wrong…

ds:340:5:Dialogue Text.source: What do you think about it?

ds:340:7:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]These ruins have been here for so long… and we don’t know enough about them… What if we did something wrong?
ds:340:7:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]이 유적은 아주 오래전부터 있었는데… 우린 아는 게 너무 적네… 혹시 뭘 잘못한 거면 어쩌지?

ds:341:3:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]What do you think it could be?? A sign? A warning?

ds:341:6:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I probably should be – but I’m so curious!

ds:341:7:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]The rest of the critters say they’ve never seen this. They say it looks ominous. But I think it looks pretty!
ds:341:7:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]다른 친구들은 이런 걸 본 적이 없대. 불길해 보인다고 해. 하지만 내 눈엔 예쁜걸!

ds:342:11:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Mate, I may be a traveler… But these critters treat me like their own. I don’t want anything bad happening to them…
ds:342:11:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]친구, 난 여행자지만… 여기 친구들은 날 식구처럼 대해 줘. 저 친구들한테 나쁜 일이 생기면 싫어…

ds:342:3:Dialogue Text.source:
I’m doing well.
What do you make of all this?
ds:342:3:Dialogue Text.target:
난 잘 지내.
넌 이거 어떻게 생각해?

ds:342:4:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Mate, I’m kinda scared… But also ready.

ds:342:6:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Yeah, I don’t know what’s coming up, but I’m prepared to do my part. Whatever needs to be done.
ds:342:6:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]응. 뭐가 다가오는지는 몰라도 내 몫을 할 준비는 됐어. 무슨 일이든 필요하다면.

ds:342:8:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Mate, I may be a traveler… But these critters treat me like their own. I don’t want anything bad happening to them…
ds:342:8:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]친구, 난 여행자지만… 여기 친구들은 날 식구처럼 대해 줘. 저 친구들한테 나쁜 일이 생기면 싫어…

ds:343:10:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I’ve tried to tell them a few times now. I’m pretty sure there’s nothin to worry about.
ds:343:10:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]벌써 몇 번이나 말해 봤어요. 걱정할 건 없을 거라고 확신해요.

ds:343:11:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Long ago, I recall stumbling across a writing that mentioned something like this.
ds:343:11:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]오래전에 이런 일을 언급한 글을 우연히 본 기억이 있어요.

ds:343:12:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Though the writing didn’t mention why, or what it meant – it definitely didn’t mention any cataclysmic events afterward.
ds:343:12:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]이유나 의미는 나와 있지 않았지만, 그 뒤에 대재앙이 일어났다는 얘기도 분명 없었어요.

ds:343:13:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Perhaps this is just a temporary phenomenon. Perhaps it’s something much more…
ds:343:13:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]그저 일시적인 현상일지도 몰라요. 아니면 훨씬 더 대단한 것일지도…

ds:343:14:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]But I don’t think anything bad will come of it.
ds:343:14:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]하지만 나쁜 일이 일어나진 않을 것 같아요.

ds:343:15:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I’ve tried to calm the critters down, but some of them can be pretty creative and get themselves worked up, heh.
ds:343:15:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]친구들을 진정시켜 봤지만, 상상력이 너무 풍부해서 스스로 겁먹는 친구들도 있더군요. 허허.

ds:343:16:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]I figured my time would be better spent studying this while it’s happening.
ds:343:16:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]이 현상이 일어나는 동안 연구하는 데 시간을 쓰는 게 낫겠다고 생각했죠.

ds:343:17:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Anyways, I should get back to it!

ds:343:269:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]It didn’t make too much sense at the time, I thought perhaps I misinterpreted it, or perhaps it was a metaphor.
ds:343:269:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]그때는 잘 이해가 안 됐어요. 제가 잘못 해석했거나, 비유가 아닐까 생각했죠.

ds:343:3:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=8]This is truly a sight to behold! I’ve never seen anything like this!
ds:343:3:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=8]정말 굉장한 광경이에요! 이런 건 본 적이 없어요!

ds:343:6:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]But there’s so much to gleam from all of this.

ds:343:7:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Look, even the glyphs that are broken off of the monolith are glowing.
ds:343:7:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]봐요. 거석에서 떨어져 나온 문자들까지 빛나고 있어요.

ds:343:8:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]You should see my collection back home, so many little runes glowing ever so slightly. [pic=3]When I first saw it, I thought I was going mad!
ds:343:8:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]집에 있는 제 수집품도 봐야 해요. 작은 룬들이 아주 희미하게 빛나고 있답니다. [pic=3]처음 봤을 땐 제가 미친 줄 알았어요!

ds:343:9:Dialogue Text.source:
A lot of the critters seem worried,
do you think this is a problem?
ds:343:9:Dialogue Text.target:
친구들이 많이 걱정하던데,
이거 문제라고 생각해?

ds:344:2:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Hey Rascal, what’s all the commotion going on?

ds:344:3:Dialogue Text.source:
There’s some stuff going on in the ruins.
You might wanna check it out!
ds:344:3:Dialogue Text.target:
유적에서 무슨 일이 생겼어.
너도 한번 가 봐!

ds:344:4:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Ruins? I’ve never seen any ruins here… but that sounds pretty interesting…
ds:344:4:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]유적? 여기서 유적을 본 적은 없는데… 꽤 흥미롭네…

ds:345:268:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]I’ll have to go see for myself.

ds:345:3:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I’ve heard there’s some exciting things happening? I was about to go check it out.
ds:345:3:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]신나는 일이 생겼다면서? 나도 막 보러 가려던 참이야.

ds:345:4:Dialogue Text.source:
Yeah, the ruins have started glowing.
It’s pretty whacky.
ds:345:4:Dialogue Text.target:
응, 유적이 빛나기 시작했어.
꽤 기묘해.

ds:345:5:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Hmm, that’s quite bizarre. I’ll have to go see for myself.

ds:346:2:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Hey Red, I hear there’s some crazy stuff going on…

ds:346:3:Dialogue Text.source:
Yeah, some of the ruins are glowing…
You should check it out!
ds:346:3:Dialogue Text.target:
응, 유적 일부가 빛나고 있어…
가 봐!

ds:346:4:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Yep, just closing up the shop here first. Definitely gotta see this for myself…
ds:346:4:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]그래, 일단 가게부터 닫고. 꼭 직접 봐야겠어…

ds:347:10:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Yeah, let’s make a trip out there soon…

ds:347:11:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Anyways, as I was saying – your sweater is all done!
ds:347:11:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]아무튼 아까 말했듯이, 네 스웨터 다 됐어!

ds:347:13:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Wait… there’s still a couple pins here…
ds:347:13:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]잠깐… 아직 핀이 몇 개 꽂혀 있는데…

ds:347:19:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]I agree! We did quite well with this one!

ds:347:26:Dialogue Text.source: PLAYER MUST WALK AROUND FOR A FEW SECONDS (not consecutively)
ds:347:26:Dialogue Text.target: PLAYER MUST WALK AROUND FOR A FEW SECONDS (not consecutively)

ds:347:2:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]There he is! Good timing too, we just finished!

ds:347:33:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Yes, that’s pretty normal. This is your first time, right?

ds:347:34:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]The fur can mingle with the cloth – but after a while it gets more comfortable
ds:347:34:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]털이 옷감에 얽힐 수 있지만, 좀 지나면 더 편해져.

ds:347:37:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]But hey, when you look this fabulous, you can’t complain!
ds:347:37:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]그래도 이렇게 멋져 보이는데 불평할 순 없잖아!

ds:347:38:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Anyways, don’t worry – You can wear it when you need to.
ds:347:38:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]아무튼 걱정 마. 필요할 때만 입어도 돼.

ds:347:3:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]But uh, what was all that hubbub about?

ds:347:40:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]You won’t hurt our feelings by not wearing it.

ds:347:42:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I’d prefer to see you nude anyways.

ds:347:48:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Let us know if any seams come loose.

ds:347:49:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]All of our clothes have a life time guarantee!

ds:347:4:Dialogue Text.source:
Something’s going on.
Some of the glyphs at the ruins are glowing.
ds:347:4:Dialogue Text.target:
무슨 일이 생겼어.
유적의 문자 일부가 빛나고 있어.

ds:348:498:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Ah~ That was fun! We ought to do that again real soon!

ds:348:501:Dialogue Text.source:
Definitely! Hopefully I can
last longer next time…
ds:348:501:Dialogue Text.target:
당연하지! 다음엔 좀 더
오래 버티면 좋겠네…

ds:348:503:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]하하, 걱정 마, 친구! 그럴 수도 있지!

ds:348:504:Dialogue Text.source:
I think I have a soft spot
for you smaller critters…
ds:348:504:Dialogue Text.target:
너희 작은 친구들한테
내가 약한가 봐…

ds:348:506:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]It’s the Magic Mabel Touch! No one can resist it!
ds:348:506:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]마법 같은 메이블의 손길이지! 아무도 못 버텨!

ds:348:510:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Gotta say though, that tongue-bath was doin’ things for me.
ds:348:510:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]그런데, 그 혀 목욕은 정말 느낌 좋더라.

ds:348:511:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]That’s definitely a big button for me!

ds:348:514:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Whew! Well that was a productive day!

ds:348:515:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I’m going to head back and chill.

ds:348:520:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Yes! We should do this again sometime!

ds:348:527:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Say big guy, you free for a bit?

ds:348:529:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]We were wondering if ya wanted to take us up on that romping we mentioned earlier…
ds:348:529:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]아까 얘기했던 것처럼 우리랑 같이 놀고 싶을까 해서…

ds:348:533:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]We’ve been stretching all day! Now we can put some of that to the test!
ds:348:533:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]온종일 늘리는 연습을 했어! 이제 시험해 볼 수 있겠네!

ds:348:535:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Not gonna lie, mate, always kinda wanted to have your claws riggling inside me…
ds:348:535:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]솔직히, 친구. 네 발톱이 내 안에서 꿈틀거리는 걸 늘 좀 느껴 보고 싶었어…

ds:348:537:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]That sounds great! Some good ole’ fashion finger blasting!

ds:348:538:Dialogue Text.source:
An order of finger blasting,
coming right up!

ds:348:543:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Haha ok you two, follow me. There’s a secluded area behind the bushes over there…
ds:348:543:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]하하, 좋아, 둘 다 따라와. 저 수풀 뒤에 한적한 곳이 있어…

ds:349:322:Dialogue Text.source: Ok Rascal! Lay on your back over there…
ds:349:322:Dialogue Text.target: 좋아, 라스칼! 저기 등을 대고 누워…

ds:349:323:Dialogue Text.source: Great! Now let’s climb on top of him.

ds:349:325:Dialogue Text.source: Damn mate, already flyin’ full mast eh?

ds:349:329:Dialogue Text.source: Alright, I think we’re ready… Watch those claws!
ds:349:329:Dialogue Text.target: 좋아, 준비된 것 같아… 발톱 조심해!

ds:349:335:Dialogue Text.source: This is so much better than our toys Mabel!

ds:349:339:Dialogue Text.source: You two are pretty dang loose! That stretching is paying off!
ds:349:339:Dialogue Text.target: 너희 둘 다 꽤 잘 늘어나네! 연습한 보람이 있어!

ds:349:341:Dialogue Text.source: We’ve been working on depth too! I bet you can get two knuckles deep on me!
ds:349:341:Dialogue Text.target: 깊이도 연습했어! 내 안에는 손가락 두 마디까지 들어올 수 있을걸!

ds:349:345:Dialogue Text.source: Mmm, don’t go much further for me, mate!
ds:349:345:Dialogue Text.target: 으음, 내 쪽은 지금보다 훨씬 깊이 넣진 말아 줘, 친구!

ds:349:346:Dialogue Text.source: You’re right up on my prostate-nnngawd it feels great!
ds:349:346:Dialogue Text.target: 바로 내 전립선에 닿고 있어. 으으, 세상에, 너무 좋아!

ds:349:348:Dialogue Text.source: Hey Dustin, gimme a hand with this guy. I wanna see him squirt~!
ds:349:348:Dialogue Text.target: 저기, 더스틴. 이 친구한테 손 좀 보태. 뿜어내는 걸 보고 싶어~!

ds:349:355:Dialogue Text.source: Mmm, that’s right mate, let it all out~

ds:349:357:Dialogue Text.source: Oooh Dustin, you got some on your face…

ds:349:361:Dialogue Text.source: Come here, I can clean you two up…
ds:349:361:Dialogue Text.target: 이리 와. 둘 다 내가 닦아 줄게…

ds:34:21:Dialogue Text.source: The very fibers of your being vibrate with joy.
ds:34:21:Dialogue Text.target: 존재의 가장 깊은 곳까지 기쁨으로 떨린다.

ds:34:23:Dialogue Text.source: It is… an extremely magnificent piece…

ds:34:25:Dialogue Text.source: Standing in the presence of this piece makes you feel complete. Nay, FULFILLED!
ds:34:25:Dialogue Text.target: 이 작품 앞에 서니 완전해진 기분이다. 아니, 충만해진 기분이다!

ds:350:37:Dialogue Text.source: This stone… It’s warm to the touch…

ds:350:38:Dialogue Text.source: You can feel an immense power flowing from within…
ds:350:38:Dialogue Text.target: 안에서 막대한 힘이 흘러나오는 게 느껴진다…

ds:351:20:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Sorry Rascal, I'm in the middle of something right now... Give me a moment...
ds:351:20:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]미안해요, 라스칼. 지금 하던 일이 있어서... 잠깐만 기다려 줘요...

ds:351:2:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Sorry Rascal, I'm in the middle of something right now... Give me a moment...
ds:351:2:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]미안해요, 라스칼. 지금 하던 일이 있어서... 잠깐만 기다려 줘요...

ds:352:49:Dialogue Text.source: A bit! Those ruins were quite something!

ds:352:51:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I hope they don’t scare ya off! I’ve grown used to your company!
ds:352:51:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]그 일 때문에 겁먹고 떠나진 말게! 자네와 함께하는 데 익숙해졌거든!

ds:352:52:Dialogue Text.source: Nah, I’m here for the long run.

ds:352:55:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Rascal! Good work again on the bridge! We appreciate your help!
ds:352:55:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]라스칼! 다리 일은 다시 한번 수고했네! 도와줘서 고마워!

ds:352:56:Dialogue Text.source: No problem! We make a great team!

ds:352:58:Dialogue Text.source: Let me know if you guys need anything else!

ds:353:32:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Our little town has some pretty interesting things going on huh?
ds:353:32:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]우리 작은 마을에서 꽤 흥미로운 일들이 벌어지고 있지?

ds:353:34:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Ok not gonna lie, things got a lot more interesting when you arrived…
ds:353:34:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]좋아, 솔직히 말할게. 네가 오고 나서 훨씬 재밌어졌어…

ds:353:36:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Hey so… When are we going on a date?

ds:353:37:Dialogue Text.source: We can go right now if you’d like!

ds:353:39:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Bah, I’ve got a thing in a bit…

ds:353:40:Dialogue Text.source: No worries, you tell me when you’re ready!

ds:354:96:Dialogue Text.source: Yeah! Whattya think about those runes?

ds:354:97:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]It’s mysterious! Adventerous! I feel like I’m in a book or something!
ds:354:97:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]신비로워! 모험 같아! 책 속에 들어온 것 같은걸!

ds:355:25:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Though I feel like it was a bit more dull before…
ds:355:25:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]그래도 전에는 좀 더 지루했던 것 같은데…

ds:355:27:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I’m just glad those runes stopped glowing!
ds:355:27:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]난 그 룬이 더는 안 빛나서 다행이야!

ds:355:33:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]That’s great to hear! Let us know if you need anything dear~!
ds:355:33:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]그거 반갑네! 필요한 게 있으면 말해, 자기야~!

ds:356:138:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]You should let us dress you up sometime.
ds:356:138:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]언제 우리가 옷 좀 입혀 보게 해 줘.

ds:356:141:Dialogue Text.source: I’m not so sure about that one…

ds:356:147:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]What did you make of those ruins?

ds:356:155:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]I put it as an accent for my hat! It was spectacular while it was glowing!

ds:356:156:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]But when the glowing stopped, I ditched it.

ds:356:161:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]C’mon Vi, you’re telling me you wouldn’t do the same?

ds:357:149:Dialogue Text.source: *Camera pans to canvas, showing new painting*
ds:357:149:Dialogue Text.target: *Camera pans to canvas, showing new painting*

ds:357:150:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Those glowing glyphs gave me some wicked cool ideas.
ds:357:150:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]그 빛나는 문자들이 정말 멋진 영감을 줬어.

ds:357:151:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I think I’ll paint a series on it…

ds:357:153:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]About the stones? I mean, it’s pretty damn weird…

ds:357:154:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]But uh, nothing bad seems to have happened.
ds:357:154:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]하지만, 어. 나쁜 일은 안 일어난 것 같아.

ds:357:158:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Things sure are pickin’ up with you around.

ds:357:160:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Yeah! Somethin’ tells me things are just getting started!
ds:357:160:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]응! 어쩐지 이제 막 시작인 것 같아!

ds:358:162:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Rascal! Gosh, I’ve been learning a lot of stuff here!
ds:358:162:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]라스칼! 세상에, 여기서 정말 많은 걸 알아내고 있어요!

ds:358:163:Dialogue Text.source: Oh? Do you know what’s going on?

ds:358:164:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I’ve cross referenced a few things, and this has indeed happened before.
ds:358:164:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]자료 몇 가지를 대조했는데, 이런 일이 전에도 있었던 건 확실해요.

ds:358:165:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]But it was a VERY long time ago. Which is great news!

ds:358:171:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]I’d love to chat Rascal, but I’ve got a lot of stuff to look through.

ds:359:207:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Now that stuff’s gettin’ a lil weird in the forest, training is more important than ever!
ds:359:207:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]숲에서 좀 이상한 일이 벌어지니까, 훈련이 어느 때보다 중요해졌어!

ds:359:213:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I’ve got a new routine set up if you’d like to give it a shot!
ds:359:213:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]원한다면 새로 짜 놓은 훈련에 도전해 봐!

ds:359:214:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]It’s the Novice level! Whattya say, mate??

ds:359:216:Dialogue Text.source: Actually let’s do the Training Routine.

ds:359:217:Dialogue Text.source: On second thought, I’ll pass for now.

ds:359:219:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Oooh, ya wanna try the Novice Track, eh? Great!

ds:359:220:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]So this one’s gonna be a lil different, mate, so pay attention!
ds:359:220:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]이번엔 좀 다를 테니까 잘 들어, 친구!

ds:359:221:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]First, this one will be a bit longer. I’ve got a bit of a routine set up for ya!
ds:359:221:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]먼저, 조금 더 오래 할 거야. 널 위한 코스를 좀 짜 놨거든!

ds:359:222:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Second, unlike the training, I’ll be going a lot harder are on ya, mate. So keep your eyes peeled!!
ds:359:222:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]둘째로, 연습과는 달리 훨씬 세게 나갈 거야. 그러니 눈 크게 뜨고 봐!!

ds:359:223:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]That said, I don’t want to hurt you, so i’ll stop the training if you get hit more than 3 times!
ds:359:223:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]그래도 널 다치게 하긴 싫으니까, 3번 넘게 맞으면 훈련을 멈출게!

ds:359:230:Dialogue Text.source: *First time you complete it, after Dustin comes crashing down with lightning*
ds:359:230:Dialogue Text.target: *First time you complete it, after Dustin comes crashing down with lightning*

ds:359:231:Dialogue Text.source: *Gameplay stops, music fades out, Cutscene mode and Rascal exclaims*
ds:359:231:Dialogue Text.target: *Gameplay stops, music fades out, Cutscene mode and Rascal exclaims*

ds:359:233:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Eh heh… Yeah sorry about that, mate…

ds:359:236:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Haha, let’s just keep that between us, eh?

ds:359:238:Dialogue Text.source: *fail out, sleep sprite fade to black go back to game world. probably autostop koreo*
ds:359:238:Dialogue Text.target: *fail out, sleep sprite fade to black go back to game world. probably autostop koreo*

ds:359:241:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]I got ya pretty good there, eh?

ds:359:242:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]You’ll have to be quicker next time!

ds:359:243:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]But eh, sorry if I went a lil hard!

ds:359:245:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Let me know if you want to try again!

ds:359:247:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Dang mate! You’re gettin’ really good at this!

ds:359:248:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I’m gonna have to really step it up!

ds:359:249:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]The next challenge I’ll have for ya will be really tough, just you wait!
ds:359:249:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]다음 도전은 정말 어려울 거야. 두고 봐!

ds:359:252:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I’m impressed! Happy to call you my pupil!

ds:359:254:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Looks like I got ya a couple times. But still, you beat the challenge!
ds:359:254:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]두 번 맞힌 것 같지만, 그래도 도전에 성공했어!

ds:359:273:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Eh heh… Yeah sorry about that, mate…

ds:359:276:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Haha, let’s just keep that between us, eh?

ds:359:290:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Dang mate! You’re gettin’ really good at this!

ds:359:294:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]You win the personal satisfaction knowing your body and mind are growing healthier!
ds:359:294:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]몸과 마음이 더 건강해진다는 걸 아는 뿌듯함을 얻잖아!

ds:359:297:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Well how about a romp in the bushes with your trainer?
ds:359:297:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]그럼 네 트레이너랑 수풀에서 한바탕 노는 건 어때?

ds:359:761:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Whew! I don’t think I’m gonna be able to take that knot anytime soon…
ds:359:761:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]후! 당분간은 그 매듭까지 받을 수 없을 것 같아…

ds:359:762:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Not sure if this is something practice can make happen…

ds:359:763:Dialogue Text.source: I’m impressed you can fit me at all!

ds:359:765:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Hah, well mate, you gotta give me some credit!

ds:359:766:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I’m not your typical squirrel, after all.

ds:359:769:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Anyways, you keep up the good work!

ds:359:770:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]The next routine will be even more challenging!

ds:35:18:Dialogue Text.source: Hmm, this looks like it’s going to be a long walk!
ds:35:18:Dialogue Text.target: 음, 꽤 오래 걸어야 할 것 같다!

ds:360:62:Dialogue Text.source: A piercing cold shoots through your body.

ds:360:66:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Right? I pulled a lot of the hues from the glowing runes!

ds:360:67:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]They’ve got this chilling quality to them, had to capture it!

ds:360:69:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Right? I wanted to capture this vast space.

ds:360:70:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Something that’s been there all along. Undisturbed, for centuries!
ds:360:70:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]쭉 그 자리에 있었던 것. 수백 년 동안 손대지 않은 채로!

ds:360:72:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Thanks buddy! Pretty proud of this one!

ds:360:74:Dialogue Text.source: A spacious illustration, featuring stunning crystal structures.
ds:360:74:Dialogue Text.target: 눈부신 수정 구조물이 담긴 광활한 공간의 그림이다.

ds:360:76:Dialogue Text.source: A chill runs through your body while peering over the painting.

ds:360:78:Dialogue Text.source: Where could such a place be? What could reside there?
ds:360:78:Dialogue Text.target: 이런 곳이 어디에 있을까? 무엇이 살고 있을까?

ds:361:264:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Oh not much. Just doing some shopping…
ds:361:264:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]아, 별일 없어. 그냥 장 좀 보려고…

ds:362:321:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]See! He’s right there! Ask him now!

ds:362:336:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]And I think I want to give it a go!

ds:362:339:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=9]But the thing is… I wanna ease into it, with a lil private version, y’know?
ds:362:339:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=9]그런데 문제는… 일단 비공개로 작게 해 보면서 익숙해지고 싶어. 알겠지?

ds:362:342:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]See, I’m a little strange when it comes to my intimate partners…
ds:362:342:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]난 은밀하게 즐길 상대를 고를 때 좀 특이하거든…

ds:362:343:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Either I know them very well like Scarlett here…

ds:362:344:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Or it’s a lot easier to do something uh… "unique" like this with folks I don’t know too well…
ds:362:344:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]아니면 이렇게, 어… ‘독특한’ 건 별로 안 친한 상대랑 하는 편이 훨씬 쉬워…

ds:362:345:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=8]It can just be a lil awkward for me to try this with our other friends…
ds:362:345:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=8]다른 친구들이랑 이런 걸 해 보기는 나한테 좀 어색해서…

ds:362:349:Dialogue Text.source: Well yeah! I’ve been doing the same thing here.
ds:362:349:Dialogue Text.target: 그럼! 나도 여기서 똑같이 하고 있잖아.

ds:362:351:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]See! I told you he’d be down!

ds:362:354:Dialogue Text.source: When and where is this all goin’ down?

ds:362:356:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]If you aren’t busy now, we can use my basement!
ds:362:356:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]지금 바쁘지 않으면 우리 집 지하실에서 하자!

ds:362:361:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]No worries honey, we can take this as slowly as ya want!
ds:362:361:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]걱정 마, 자기야. 네가 원하는 만큼 천천히 해도 돼!

ds:362:364:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Sometimes ya gotta push the bird out of the nest, y’know? Bawkaw!
ds:362:364:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]가끔은 새를 둥지 밖으로 밀어내야지. 그렇지? 푸하!

ds:363:581:Dialogue Text.source: Yep! Now bend over so I can get this harness around you…
ds:363:581:Dialogue Text.target: 응! 이제 몸을 숙여 봐. 이 하네스를 둘러 줄게…

ds:363:582:Dialogue Text.source: OK! I’m gonna put this ball gag on ya now, are ya ready?
ds:363:582:Dialogue Text.target: 좋아! 이제 볼 개그를 채울 거야. 준비됐어?

ds:363:586:Dialogue Text.source: Oh, do you want blinders on?

ds:363:588:Dialogue Text.source: No, not this time. I’d like to see!
ds:363:588:Dialogue Text.target: 아니, 이번엔 안 할래. 보고 싶어!

ds:363:591:Dialogue Text.source: How’s the view back there Rascal?

ds:363:593:Dialogue Text.source: Lookin’ great! Let me know when she’s ready!

ds:363:596:Dialogue Text.source: Aww look how cute she is with that ballgag on.
ds:363:596:Dialogue Text.target: 아, 볼 개그를 하니까 정말 귀엽네.

ds:363:598:Dialogue Text.source: Oop, you’re drooling a bit, lemme get that for ya!
ds:363:598:Dialogue Text.target: 어머, 침이 좀 흐르네. 내가 닦아 줄게!

ds:363:602:Dialogue Text.source: I’m gonna start warming her up back here, is that ok!
ds:363:602:Dialogue Text.target: 여기 뒤쪽을 좀 풀어 주기 시작할게. 괜찮지!

ds:363:610:Dialogue Text.source: Haha, that’s my girl! She’s my absolute favorite to play with for that very reason!
ds:363:610:Dialogue Text.target: 하하, 역시 우리 페니야! 바로 그래서 난 이 애랑 노는 게 제일 좋아!

ds:363:612:Dialogue Text.source: Ok, I’m gonna go for it.

ds:363:620:Dialogue Text.source: How are ya doin’ back there?

ds:363:623:Dialogue Text.source: Haven’t done this with a bird before!
ds:363:623:Dialogue Text.target: 새랑 이렇게 해 보는 건 처음이야!

ds:363:628:Dialogue Text.source: Oooh, she’s close, I can tell.

ds:363:639:Dialogue Text.source: Gosh Rascal, you were really gettin’ in there!

ds:363:641:Dialogue Text.source: Can ya blame me? You’re so soft back here!
ds:363:641:Dialogue Text.target: 그럴 수밖에 없지! 이 뒤가 너무 부드럽잖아!

ds:363:644:Dialogue Text.source: Rascal… You know there’s two holes in there, right?
ds:363:644:Dialogue Text.target: 라스칼… 그 안에 구멍이 두 개 있는 거 알지?

ds:363:646:Dialogue Text.source: Oooh, y’know. I thought I felt something different every so often…
ds:363:646:Dialogue Text.target: 아아, 있잖아. 가끔 다른 느낌이 난다고 생각했어…

ds:363:647:Dialogue Text.source: You are my first bird. I hope I didn’t hurt you.
ds:363:647:Dialogue Text.target: 새 상대는 네가 처음이라서. 아프게 하지 않았으면 좋겠네.

ds:363:649:Dialogue Text.source: No no, it was quite exciting! I didn’t know what to expect, and that’s the whole allure of this thing!
ds:363:649:Dialogue Text.target: 아냐, 아냐. 정말 짜릿했어! 뭘 기대해야 할지 몰랐는데, 그게 바로 이런 놀이의 매력이잖아!

ds:363:651:Dialogue Text.source: Gah, dear you’re so cute when you’re satisfied, I simply must smooch you~
ds:363:651:Dialogue Text.target: 아, 자기야. 만족한 모습이 너무 귀여워서 꼭 뽀뽀해야겠어~

ds:363:653:Dialogue Text.source: Baww haha, thanks for this you two…

ds:363:655:Dialogue Text.source: Think you’re ready to go public?
ds:363:655:Dialogue Text.target: 공개적으로 할 준비 된 것 같아?

ds:363:661:Dialogue Text.source: Haha that’s ok- Oh, I think she wants the gag out.
ds:363:661:Dialogue Text.target: 하하, 괜찮아. 아, 개그를 빼 달라는 것 같네.

ds:363:663:Dialogue Text.source: But I definitely want to do this again…
ds:363:663:Dialogue Text.target: 하지만 꼭 다시 해 보고 싶어…

ds:363:666:Dialogue Text.source: I haven’t had a go with ya yet!

ds:363:667:Dialogue Text.source: I’ve got a few toys I think you’d love…
ds:363:667:Dialogue Text.target: 네가 좋아할 만한 장난감도 좀 있어…

ds:363:671:Dialogue Text.source: Oooh, I’d love to see that! But gosh I’m beat.
ds:363:671:Dialogue Text.target: 오오, 보고 싶다! 그런데 세상에, 너무 지쳤네.

ds:363:672:Dialogue Text.source: I think I’ll leave you two to it!
ds:363:672:Dialogue Text.target: 너희 둘이 마저 즐기게 가 줄게!

ds:363:674:Dialogue Text.source: Aw, ok hun. Thanks for helping me out!

ds:363:676:Dialogue Text.source: We’ll catch you up on our shenanigans later!
ds:363:676:Dialogue Text.target: 나중에 우리가 뭘 하고 놀았는지 알려 줄게!

ds:363:677:Dialogue Text.source: Thanks for warming her up for me!
ds:363:677:Dialogue Text.target: 날 위해 페니 몸을 풀어 줘서 고마워!

ds:363:678:Dialogue Text.source: Now for the real fun to begin…

ds:364:25:Dialogue Text.source: The entrance is a little bit of a squeeze…

ds:364:26:Dialogue Text.source: You can see a lot of miscellaneous cloth materials scattered about.
ds:364:26:Dialogue Text.target: 다양한 천 조각들이 흩어져 있는 게 보인다.

ds:365:30:Dialogue Text.source: Looks like the path continues here…

ds:366:33:Dialogue Text.source: This must be where Augustus lives… But he’s not home at the moment…
ds:366:33:Dialogue Text.target: 아우구스투스가 사는 곳인 것 같다… 하지만 지금은 집에 없다…

ds:366:34:Dialogue Text.source: You can make out a bunch of papers and rocks inside.

ds:367:83:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Hmm… This one I didn’t quite finish…

ds:367:84:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Kinda got bored of it halway through.

ds:367:87:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Instead of wasting my time or paint, it’s a better idea to just stop and try something else.
ds:367:87:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]시간이랑 물감을 낭비하느니 그냥 그만두고 다른 걸 해 보는 게 더 좋지.

ds:367:88:Dialogue Text.source: A vast space, with a single illuminated rune.
ds:367:88:Dialogue Text.target: 드넓은 공간에 룬 하나만 빛나고 있다.

ds:367:90:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I think I’ll try this one again sometime.

ds:367:91:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]I had a striking idea in my head, but as I started painting, the idea kinda shifted to this.
ds:367:91:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]머릿속에는 강렬한 구상이 있었는데, 막상 그리기 시작하니 이런 쪽으로 바뀌었어.

ds:367:92:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]But it’s not as striking as I wanted it to be, so maybe next time.
ds:367:92:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]하지만 원하던 만큼 강렬하진 않아서, 다음을 기약해야겠네.

ds:367:97:Dialogue Text.source: A chill runs through your body while peering over the painting.

ds:367:99:Dialogue Text.source: As you focus on the symbol, you could feel your vision tunneling…
ds:367:99:Dialogue Text.target: 그 상징에 집중하자, 시야가 좁아지는 듯한 느낌이 든다…

ds:368:105:Dialogue Text.source: Looks spooky! Do you often to portraits?

ds:368:106:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I don’t! Well, not for fun at least.

ds:368:107:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I do the occasional study here and there.

ds:368:108:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]But I dreamt this figure up a bit ago. I had to try to capture it!
ds:368:108:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]그런데 얼마 전에 이 형상을 떠올렸어. 꼭 담아 보고 싶었지!

ds:368:109:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I don’t think I fully got it… but… still came out pretty well.
ds:368:109:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]완벽하게 담진 못한 것 같지만… 그래도 꽤 잘 나왔어.

ds:368:112:Dialogue Text.source:
Say, are there creatures
like that in this forest?
ds:368:112:Dialogue Text.target:
그런데 이 숲에도
저런 생물이 있어?

ds:368:113:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Not that I’ve seen! But who knows.
ds:368:113:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]내가 본 적은 없어! 하지만 누가 알겠어.

ds:368:115:Dialogue Text.source: A fierce creature peers back at you.
ds:368:115:Dialogue Text.target: 사나운 생물이 당신을 마주 보고 있다.

ds:368:117:Dialogue Text.source: A chill runs through your body while peering over the painting.

ds:368:119:Dialogue Text.source: Its eyes are captivating… They seem to be analyzing everything about you…
ds:368:119:Dialogue Text.target: 시선을 사로잡는 눈이다… 당신의 모든 것을 분석하는 것 같다…

ds:369:202:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]There’s a few other critters that you’ve yet to meet.
ds:369:202:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]아직 못 만나 본 숲속 친구들이 몇 명 있을 거야.

ds:369:203:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I’ll go ahead and jot them down in your Quest Log - I’m sure you’ll meet them on your own. But you can read up on it there!
ds:369:203:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]퀘스트 기록에 적어 줄게. 돌아다니다 보면 만나겠지만, 거기서 찾아봐도 돼!

ds:369:204:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Once you’ve met all the critters here, I’ll have a special request for ya!

ds:378:291:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]But seriously, I had A LOT to drink, and a lot of the events are pretty dang fuzzy…

ds:378:292:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Y’know, you might be able to help me figure out what happened…
ds:378:292:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]있지, 네가 무슨 일이 있었는지 알아내는 걸 도와줄 수도 있겠다…

ds:378:294:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Well we’ve tried to piece this together before, but a lot of the critters keep getting their stories confused.
ds:378:294:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]전에도 맞춰 보려고 했는데, 다들 자꾸 이야기를 헷갈리더라고.

ds:378:295:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]I think if we had a non-biased third party collect information, that’s you, then we might be able to figure out what actually happened!
ds:378:295:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]편견 없는 제삼자가 정보를 모으면, 그러니까 네가 해 주면, 실제로 무슨 일이 있었는지 알 수 있을 거야!

ds:378:299:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]So last Blessing, I wanted to do something special for the holidays.
ds:378:299:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]지난 축복제 때는 명절을 맞아 특별한 걸 하고 싶었어.

ds:378:300:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Peter and Scarlett were throwing a party at their house, and I asked if I could set up an attraction! They said yes.
ds:378:300:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]피터랑 스칼렛이 집에서 파티를 열어서, 내가 놀 거리를 마련해도 되냐고 물었지! 좋다고 했어.

ds:378:301:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]It wasn’t exactly related to the holiday, but I thought it would be fun to set up a kissing booth!
ds:378:301:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]명절이랑 직접 관련은 없었지만, 키스 부스를 열면 재밌을 것 같았거든!

ds:378:303:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Once you’ve got the whole story, come back to me to corroborate!
ds:378:303:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]이야기를 다 알아내면 돌아와서 같이 확인해 보자!

ds:378:304:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Make sure you talk to Penny and Augustus too! They can tell you all about the holiday!
ds:378:304:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]페니랑 아우구스투스한테도 꼭 얘기해 봐! 축제에 대해 전부 알려 줄 거야!

ds:378:307:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]But I think things started to really pick up when Claire and Violet entered the picture…
ds:378:307:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]하지만 클레어랑 바이올렛이 나타나고부터 본격적으로 일이 벌어진 것 같아…

ds:378:308:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Y’know how devious they are, but GOSH are they fun at parties! They can mix a mean cocktail too!
ds:378:308:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]얼마나 짓궂은지 알지? 그런데 파티에선 정말 재밌어! 칵테일도 끝내주게 만들고!

ds:378:309:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]SOO a few mouse-sized cocktails later, I was feeling pretty good!
ds:378:309:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]그래서 생쥐 크기로 만든 칵테일을 몇 잔 마시니까 기분이 꽤 좋아졌지!

ds:378:310:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]The girls said I needed to pay them for the drinks! With smooches! But boy did they have something else in mind!
ds:378:310:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]걔들이 술값을 내야 한다더라! 키스로! 그런데 생각한 건 전혀 달랐지!

ds:378:311:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]I’ll be honest… at this point, I had a LOT to drink, so I’m pretty fuzzy about it all…
ds:378:311:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]솔직히… 그때쯤엔 술을 엄청 마셔서, 전부 꽤 흐릿해…

ds:378:313:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]This brings us to our first interview! Claire and Violet! They’ll know what happened…
ds:378:313:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]그러니 첫 면담 상대는 클레어랑 바이올렛이야! 무슨 일이 있었는지 알 거야…

ds:378:316:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Once you’ve got the whole story, come back to me to corroborate!
ds:378:316:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]이야기를 다 알아내면 돌아와서 같이 확인해 보자!

ds:378:317:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Make sure you talk to Penny too! They can tell you all about the holiday!
ds:378:317:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]페니한테도 꼭 얘기해 봐! 축제에 대해 전부 알려 줄 거야!

ds:379:699:Dialogue Text.source: Y’know, charge a lil eggnog, smooch a cute lil mouse. What’s not to love?
ds:379:699:Dialogue Text.target: 있지, 에그노그 조금 받고 귀여운 생쥐랑 키스하는 거야. 뭐가 싫겠어?

ds:379:700:Dialogue Text.source: So all night long, I was exchanging smooches with all the guests of the party!
ds:379:700:Dialogue Text.target: 그래서 온밤 파티 손님들이랑 키스를 주고받았어!

ds:379:701:Dialogue Text.source: It was pretty innocent at first, lil smooches on the cheek, quick pecks on the lips. And nice portions of eggnog, nothing too crazy.
ds:379:701:Dialogue Text.target: 처음엔 꽤 순진했지. 볼에 살짝 뽀뽀하거나, 입술에 짧게 입 맞추고. 에그노그도 적당히 마셨고, 별로 대단한 건 없었어.

ds:379:702:Dialogue Text.source: Well as the night crept on, some of the critters started getting pretty sloshed…
ds:379:702:Dialogue Text.target: 그런데 밤이 깊어지면서 몇몇 친구들이 꽤 취하기 시작했지…

ds:379:704:Dialogue Text.source: I remember making out with Dustin for like, 5 minutes.
ds:379:704:Dialogue Text.target: 더스틴이랑 한 5분 동안 진하게 키스한 게 기억나.

ds:379:706:Dialogue Text.source: Then I remember Maverick giving me quite a bit of smooches all over my body…
ds:379:706:Dialogue Text.target: 그다음엔 매버릭이 내 온몸에 잔뜩 뽀뽀해 줬던 게 기억나고…

ds:379:708:Dialogue Text.source: Finley straight up gave me a tongue bath!
ds:379:708:Dialogue Text.target: 핀리는 아예 혀로 목욕을 시켜 줬어!

ds:37:26:Dialogue Text.target: PLAYER CAN NOW CHECK OUT THE ITEMS – Player will interact with each item, Maverick will chime in, and the player response-prompt will pop up with “I’ll buy it!” or “Maybe not…”

ds:37:29:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Typical Glass Jar! Sturdy! Great for carrying stuff. Includes the cap!
ds:37:29:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]평범한 유리병! 튼튼하지! 물건을 담아 다니기 좋아. 뚜껑도 포함이야!

ds:37:32:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I’m not actually sure what these are for…
ds:37:32:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]사실 이게 어디 쓰는 건지는 잘 모르겠는데…

ds:37:33:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]but you could probably cut stuff… That’s probably something, right?
ds:37:33:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]뭔가 자를 수는 있겠지… 그것도 쓸모 있는 거잖아?

ds:37:37:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]It’s pretty old, but still sharp and dangerous! I can’t let go of this for cheap!
ds:37:37:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]꽤 오래됐지만, 아직 날카롭고 위험하지! 싸게 넘길 순 없어!

ds:37:44:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Sorry bud, looks like you don’t have the coin for this!
ds:37:44:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]미안, 친구. 이걸 살 돈이 부족한 것 같아!

ds:380:446:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]I thought I could get my tongue in Mabel’s butt. Not the whole thing, but like, IN. Y’know?
ds:380:446:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]내 혀를 메이블 엉덩이에 넣을 수 있을 것 같았어. 통째로는 아니어도, 어쨌든 안에. 알겠지?

ds:380:459:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Anyways, we moseyed on over to her little booth, and started chatting her up.
ds:380:459:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]아무튼 그 작은 부스로 슬슬 다가가서 말을 걸었지.

ds:380:460:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Claire can make a mean cocktail, so I had her mix us up a few.
ds:380:460:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]클레어는 칵테일을 끝내주게 만들어서, 몇 잔 섞어 달라고 했어.

ds:380:462:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]They’re killer, I’ll make you one sometime.

ds:380:464:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Mabel ended up downing two or three of them.

ds:380:465:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=8]So naturally we needed her to "pay up" in the form of kisses of course.

ds:380:466:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I’m not gonna lie, that party was a blurrrr.

ds:380:467:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]It went pretty dang late for us too, I think our night was really just starting with Mabel.
ds:380:467:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]우리도 꽤 늦게까지 놀았어. 메이블을 만났을 때가 밤의 시작이었던 것 같네.

ds:380:469:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]She was but a supple appetizer for our festive appetites.
ds:380:469:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]그 애는 한껏 들뜬 우리 입맛을 돋우는 말랑한 전채 요리였을 뿐이지.

ds:380:474:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]… Y’know honestly, I’m kinda drawing a blank.

ds:380:475:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I know we licked her but like…?

ds:380:482:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]So Claire and I were eyeing Mable’s kissing booth all night.
ds:380:482:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]클레어랑 난 온밤 메이블의 키스 부스를 눈여겨보고 있었어.

ds:380:483:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]We just saw her get a full on tongue bath by Finley and we thought we had to get in on that!
ds:380:483:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]핀리가 혀로 제대로 목욕시켜 주는 걸 보고, 우리도 끼어야겠다고 생각했지!

ds:380:484:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]To make things a bit more interesting, we made a bet between each other.
ds:380:484:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]좀 더 재밌게 하려고 서로 내기를 했어.

ds:380:485:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]We figured our job was done, and Dustin and Maverick looked like they could use a paw…
ds:380:485:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]우리 일은 끝났고, 더스틴이랑 매버릭은 손길이 좀 필요해 보였지…

ds:380:488:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Ah yes, those boys are a lot of fun!

ds:380:489:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=9]But I don’t really recall seeing Mabel for the rest of the night after that…
ds:380:489:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=9]그런데 그 뒤로 그날 밤엔 메이블을 본 기억이 별로 없어…

ds:380:491:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Right, that’s the last we saw of her.

ds:380:492:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]You’d have to ask Bucky for the rest.

ds:380:493:Dialogue Text.source: Ok will do, and thanks for that steamy story!

ds:380:495:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Of course, and… If you got time…

ds:380:496:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Maybe ask Maverick and Dustin what the four of us got up to too, hehe…
ds:380:496:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]우리 넷이 뭘 했는지도 매버릭이랑 더스틴한테 물어봐. 헤헤…

ds:380:499:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=8]It wasn’t long before we had her shivering in pleasure
ds:380:499:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=8]얼마 안 가서 메이블은 쾌감에 떨고 있었지.

ds:380:500:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Once we cleaned her up, we noticed Dustin and Maverick watching the whole thing from across the room.
ds:380:500:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]닦아 주고 나니, 더스틴이랑 매버릭이 방 건너편에서 전부 보고 있더라.

ds:380:504:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Oh yeah, apparently we put on quite a show…
ds:380:504:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]아, 맞아. 우리가 볼거리를 꽤 제공했나 봐…

ds:380:505:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Anyways, Claire and I turned to see Bucky had swooped up Mabel and they were chatting.
ds:380:505:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]아무튼 돌아보니 버키가 메이블을 집어 들어서 얘기하고 있었어.

ds:380:508:Dialogue Text.source:
Actually, I wanted to know what trouble
you two got up to with Mabel last Blessing!
ds:380:508:Dialogue Text.target:
사실 지난 축복제 때 너희 둘이 메이블이랑
무슨 사고를 쳤는지 알고 싶어서!

ds:380:512:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]He probably means when we mixed her some drinks.
ds:380:512:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]메이블한테 술을 만들어 줬을 때를 말하나 봐.

ds:381:711:Dialogue Text.source: First I got to work loosening her up.
ds:381:711:Dialogue Text.target: 먼저 그 애 몸을 풀어 주기 시작했어.

ds:381:712:Dialogue Text.source: It didn’t take long, I think she was pretty worked up from all of the more… intimate kisses she had.
ds:381:712:Dialogue Text.target: 오래 걸리지 않았지. 그동안 받았던 더… 은밀한 키스들 때문에 꽤 달아올라 있었던 것 같아.

ds:381:713:Dialogue Text.source: Claire was on support, giving her cute lil’ nuzzles and licks.
ds:381:713:Dialogue Text.target: 클레어는 옆에서 도와주며 귀엽게 코를 비비고 핥아 줬어.

ds:381:714:Dialogue Text.source: I could tell Mabel was nice and ready, so I proceeded…
ds:381:714:Dialogue Text.target: 메이블이 제대로 준비된 걸 알 수 있어서 계속했지…

ds:381:716:Dialogue Text.source: Just as I thought, a bit of pressure and my tongue sunk in!
ds:381:716:Dialogue Text.target: 생각대로 조금 힘을 주니 혀가 쑥 들어갔어!

ds:381:719:Dialogue Text.source: She’s also got a thing for maws. So I was happy to indulge.
ds:381:719:Dialogue Text.target: 입이랑 턱에 끌리잖아. 나야 기꺼이 즐겁게 해 줬지.

ds:381:720:Dialogue Text.source: I gave her a nice view of the pearly whites and licked her all over.
ds:381:720:Dialogue Text.target: 새하얀 이빨을 잘 보여 주면서 온몸을 핥았어.

ds:382:516:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Hey Rascal! How can I help ya?

ds:382:517:Dialogue Text.source: Can ya tell me about The Blessing last year?
ds:382:517:Dialogue Text.target: 작년 축복제 얘기 좀 해 줄래?

ds:382:518:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]The Blessing? Well sure but uh… It was a bit ago…
ds:382:518:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]축복제? 물론이지. 다만, 어… 좀 된 일이라…

ds:382:519:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]But I can tell ya to the best I can!

ds:382:521:Dialogue Text.source: I heard you and Mabel got together for a bit?

ds:382:522:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Oh! Gosh what a nice little night that was.

ds:382:523:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Now the details are a little fuzzy, so bear with me…

ds:382:524:Dialogue Text.source: No problem, just tell me what ya remember!

ds:382:525:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Ok, I think I saw the tail-end of the coyotes having their fun with Mabel.
ds:382:525:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]좋아. 코요테들이 메이블과 노는 마지막 부분을 봤던 것 같네.

ds:382:526:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]She looked pretty tuckered out, so I invited her to come rest with me.
ds:382:526:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]꽤 지쳐 보이길래 나랑 같이 쉬자고 했지.

ds:382:527:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]See, I was pretty tired from the evening already, and a bit of alcohol always gets me nice and sleepy.
ds:382:527:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]난 벌써 그날 저녁에 꽤 지쳤거든. 술도 조금만 마시면 기분 좋게 졸리고.

ds:382:528:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]But I guess Mabel must’ve had other plans…

ds:382:529:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I can get a little naughty when I’m buzzed, and she was pushing all of my buttons that night.
ds:382:529:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]난 취기가 돌면 좀 야해지는데, 그날 밤 그 애가 내 흥분 스위치를 죄다 눌렀지.

ds:382:530:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Well… one thing lead to another and, gosh I’m so embarrassed!

ds:382:533:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]She started getting really in-depth with some of the stretch sessions she’ll do with toys I’ve made her.
ds:382:533:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]내가 만들어 준 장난감으로 하는 확장 연습 얘기를 아주 자세히 하기 시작했어.

ds:382:534:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]To be honest, I don’t even really remember the details…
ds:382:534:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]솔직히 자세한 건 잘 기억도 안 나네…

ds:382:535:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I think I fell asleep, not seconds after. Quite embarrassing really heh…
ds:382:535:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]몇 초도 안 지나서 잠들었던 것 같아. 정말 창피하지. 허허…

ds:382:536:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]But I know Peter and Scarlett were close. I could hear them giggling nearby during our… massage…
ds:382:536:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]하지만 피터랑 스칼렛이 가까이 있었던 건 알아. 우리가… 마사지하는 동안… 근처에서 킥킥거리는 게 들렸거든.

ds:382:537:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Y’know I woke up totally cleaned up and tucked in too! So I bet they came swooping in after I was done.
ds:382:537:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]깨어나 보니 몸도 말끔하고 이불도 덮여 있었지! 그러니 내가 끝나고 나서 그 둘이 나섰을 걸세.

ds:382:539:Dialogue Text.source: Will do! Thanks for catching me up!

ds:382:541:Dialogue Text.source:
Naw, I just wanted to say you shouldn’t
be so embarrassed. Mabel’s adorable.
ds:382:541:Dialogue Text.target:
아냐, 그냥 너무 부끄러워하지 말라고
하고 싶었어. 메이블은 귀엽잖아.

ds:382:542:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Oh it’s not Mabel I’m embarrassed about.

ds:382:543:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I was embarrassed for falling asleep on her.

ds:383:710:Dialogue Text.source: After a while, I was red in the face, and completely full mast.
ds:383:710:Dialogue Text.target: 조금 지나니 얼굴은 빨갛고, 완전히 서 있었네.

ds:383:711:Dialogue Text.source: The devil knew exactly what she wanted too! Like clockwork!
ds:383:711:Dialogue Text.target: 그 악마 같은 애는 자기가 원하는 것도 정확히 알더군! 아주 착착 진행됐지!

ds:383:712:Dialogue Text.source: She cozied all down next to my shaft and… gosh…
ds:383:712:Dialogue Text.target: 내 자지 옆에 포근히 자리 잡더니… 세상에…

ds:383:713:Dialogue Text.source: I’ll spare you the details, but it got messy…

ds:384:517:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Did you hear about all the crazy stuff Mabel was up to?

ds:384:518:Dialogue Text.source:
I’ve heard a lot!
Except the part where you two came in.
ds:384:518:Dialogue Text.target:
많이 들었어!
너희 둘이 나선 부분만 빼고.

ds:384:520:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]See, love? I told you we should have just told the poor lad!
ds:384:520:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]거봐, 여보? 그냥 이 친구한테 말해 주자고 했잖아!

ds:384:521:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]We had him running about just to come back to us!
ds:384:521:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]이리저리 돌아다니다가 결국 우리한테 다시 오게 만들었네!

ds:384:523:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Nonsense! We didn’t see everything, he woulda missed out on some juicy details!
ds:384:523:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]무슨 소리야! 우린 전부 보지 못했잖아. 흥미로운 속사정을 놓쳤을걸!

ds:384:524:Dialogue Text.source: There have been some seriously juicy details!

ds:384:527:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]We wouldn’t want Rascal to miss out on those juicy details.
ds:384:527:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]라스칼이 그런 자세한 얘기를 놓치게 할 순 없잖아.

ds:384:530:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]So where did Mabel’s story leave off?

ds:384:531:Dialogue Text.source: I believe she just tuckered out Bucky.
ds:384:531:Dialogue Text.target: 버키를 완전히 지치게 한 데까지인 것 같아.

ds:384:533:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Oh that’s right! GOSH, that was messy!

ds:384:537:Dialogue Text.source:
He seemed a bit reserved
telling the whole thing…
ds:384:537:Dialogue Text.target:
전부 말하기는
좀 쑥스러워하는 것 같더라고…

ds:384:540:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I suppose the chap’s not one to gloat…

ds:384:545:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Honestly it’s a wonder he can still be so… virile…
ds:384:545:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]솔직히 아직도 그렇게… 정력이 넘친다는 게 신기해…

ds:384:547:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Right? Even our bodies are starting to slow down!
ds:384:547:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]그렇지? 우리 몸도 슬슬 예전 같지 않은데!

ds:384:554:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]So there Scarlett and I were, cleaning up some empty glasses and bottles.
ds:384:554:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]스칼렛이랑 난 빈 잔과 병들을 치우고 있었어.

ds:384:555:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Penny and Augustus seemed to be having an engaging conversation about the festivities.
ds:384:555:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]페니랑 아우구스투스는 축제에 대해 흥미진진한 대화를 나누는 것 같았고.

ds:384:556:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Dustin and Maverick had just settled down for a nap. I believe the coyotes had just finished up with them.
ds:384:556:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]더스틴이랑 매버릭은 막 잠깐 눈을 붙이려고 누웠지. 코요테들이 방금 둘과 노는 걸 끝냈던 것 같아.

ds:384:558:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]That’s right! They were heading toward Finley. He seemed pretty interested in their lil’ four-way…
ds:384:558:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]맞아! 코요테들은 핀리 쪽으로 가고 있었어. 핀리도 그 넷이 노는 걸 꽤 관심 있게 봤거든…

ds:384:560:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]And finally we come upon Bucky and Mabel…

ds:384:562:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Poor ole Bucky was plum-tuckered out afterward!

ds:384:563:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]I could see it in his face, he needed sleep. So that’s when we took over!
ds:384:563:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]얼굴만 봐도 잠이 필요한 걸 알겠더라. 그래서 우리가 나섰지!

ds:384:564:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]We got the two of them cleaned up and tucked Bucky in our bed.
ds:384:564:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]둘을 말끔히 닦아 주고 버키는 우리 침대에 눕혔어.

ds:384:565:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Afterward, Mabel was still rearing to go! That girl is CRAZY!
ds:384:565:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]그런데 메이블은 여전히 더 할 기세더라! 그 애 정말 못 말려!

ds:384:566:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=8]She asked if I had any toys lying around.

ds:384:568:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]And it’s Scarlett we’re talking about, here. Of course she has toys laying around…

ds:384:570:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]And what is that supposed to mean?

ds:384:572:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Just that you’re well prepared, love! Nothing more…
ds:384:572:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]그냥 준비성이 좋다는 거지, 여보! 다른 뜻 없어…

ds:384:574:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Mmhmm, you don’t seem to mind when I’ve always got something fun to stick up your bum!
ds:384:574:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]으음, 당신 엉덩이에 넣을 재밌는 걸 항상 갖고 있을 땐 싫어하지 않잖아!

ds:384:578:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Anywho, as I was saying. It looks like Mabel wanted to have some toy fun, and I had just the thing!
ds:384:578:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]아무튼 아까 말했듯이, 메이블은 장난감으로 놀고 싶은 것 같았고, 나한테 딱 좋은 게 있었지!

ds:384:579:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]She always wanted to try this knotted toy I have, what better opportunity?
ds:384:579:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]내 매듭 달린 장난감을 늘 써 보고 싶어 했거든. 그보다 좋은 기회가 있겠어?

ds:384:581:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Gosh the gape on that lil’ mouse when you pulled that toy out…
ds:384:581:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]세상에, 그걸 빼고 나니 작은 생쥐 구멍이 그렇게 벌어져서…

ds:384:582:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]WHEW, ok, I need to calm down…

ds:384:584:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Hah, I’ll take over dear, you run some cold water over your face.
ds:384:584:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]하, 내가 이어서 말할게, 여보. 가서 얼굴에 찬물 좀 끼얹어.

ds:384:585:Dialogue Text.source: I could use some cold water too…

ds:384:586:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Hah! So after that, we cleaned up Mabel AGAIN. And then she was totally spent.
ds:384:586:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]하! 그 뒤로 메이블을 또 닦아 줬어. 그때는 완전히 지쳤더라.

ds:384:587:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]So we tucked her in next to Bucky, and continued cleaning up from the party.
ds:384:587:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]그래서 버키 옆에 눕혀 주고, 파티 뒤처리를 계속했지.

ds:384:588:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=8]I think at that point, everyone was basically asleep.

ds:384:589:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Finley and the coyotes were cuddled up together at the foot of the bed.
ds:384:589:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]핀리랑 코요테들은 침대 발치에서 서로 껴안고 있었고.

ds:384:590:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Dustin and Maverick were passed out on some cushions.

ds:384:591:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=8]It was about time to wind down ourselves, but then we saw Augustus and Penny off to the side…
ds:384:591:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=8]우리도 이제 쉴 때가 됐는데, 한쪽에 있는 아우구스투스랑 페니가 보였어…

ds:384:593:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Well, this doesn’t have to do with Mabel shenanigans… But an interesting bit of gossip none the less…
ds:384:593:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]뭐, 이건 메이블의 장난과는 상관없지만… 그래도 흥미로운 소문이지…

ds:384:594:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=8]Now, I’m trying to respect their boundaries, as both of them are more private lovers…
ds:384:594:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=8]둘 다 은밀한 걸 더 좋아하니까, 선은 지켜 주려고 하지만…

ds:384:595:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]But that’s also why this was so interesting!

ds:384:597:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=8]Well, as far as I know, Augustus and Penny haven’t been too sexually active with eachother…
ds:384:597:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=8]내가 아는 한 아우구스투스랑 페니는 서로 성적으로 아주 활발한 사이는 아니었어…

ds:384:598:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]BUT as I said, they are much more private than most, so who knows.
ds:384:598:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]하지만 말했듯이 대부분보다 훨씬 비밀스럽게 즐기니까, 누가 알겠어.

ds:384:600:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]At this point, we decided to duck out and give them their privacy.
ds:384:600:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]그때쯤 우린 자리를 피해 둘만 있게 해 주기로 했지.

ds:384:601:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]And honestly good for Penny, I hope she keeps finding ways comfortable for her to get her rocks off!
ds:384:601:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]솔직히 페니가 잘됐다 싶었어. 자기가 편한 방식으로 즐기는 방법을 계속 찾으면 좋겠어!

ds:384:603:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Love, you didn’t mention the most interesting part…
ds:384:603:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]여보, 제일 흥미로운 부분은 말 안 했네…

ds:384:605:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Oh that’s right! Yes, here’s what was crazy.

ds:384:606:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Now the two were very quiet. Augustus was whispering under his breath talking to her…
ds:384:606:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]둘이 아주 조용했거든. 아우구스투스가 작은 목소리로 속삭이며 말하는데…

ds:384:607:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=8]And I kid you not, he kept calling her "Felicity."

ds:384:612:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]No idea. There’s never been a critter here named that.
ds:384:612:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]몰라. 여기 그런 이름의 친구는 한 번도 없었어.

ds:384:613:Dialogue Text.source: You haven’t asked them about it?

ds:384:615:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=8]Naw… I kinda wanted them to have that moment for themselves. So I never asked.
ds:384:615:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=8]아니… 그 순간은 둘만 간직하게 해 주고 싶었어. 그래서 안 물었지.

ds:384:618:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Anyways, Peter and I were cleaning up some food and drinks, and then we see Augustus and Penny cuddled up.
ds:384:618:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]아무튼 피터랑 음식과 술을 치우고 있었는데, 아우구스투스랑 페니가 꼭 껴안고 있었어.

ds:384:619:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Like QUITE close. Definitely up to something. So we quietly snuck our way closer…
ds:384:619:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]아주 가까이 붙어서 말이야. 분명 뭔가 하고 있었지. 그래서 조용히 더 가까이 갔어…

ds:384:620:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Y’know… to make sure everything was ok. And not to creep on our friends…
ds:384:620:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]있잖아… 다 괜찮은지 보려고. 친구들을 훔쳐보려던 게 아니라…

ds:384:622:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Anywho that’s it. We finished a bit of cleaning.
ds:384:622:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]아무튼 그게 다야. 청소를 조금 더 했어.

ds:384:623:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Then Peter had a stiffy that "needed tending to." So after a minute or so we were asleep.
ds:384:623:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]그러고 나니 피터 물건이 서서 ‘손길이 필요’했지. 그래서 일 분쯤 뒤에는 잠들었어.

ds:384:629:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Anyways that’s the end of our part.

ds:384:630:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Gosh what a night though. Can’t wait for the next one!

ds:384:633:Dialogue Text.source: I’ll be there, I’ll be there!

ds:384:636:Dialogue Text.source: It does! I think I’ve got it all figured out.
ds:384:636:Dialogue Text.target: 응! 이제 전부 알 것 같아.

ds:384:639:Dialogue Text.source: I gotta let Mabel know what fun she got up to.
ds:384:639:Dialogue Text.target: 메이블한테 자기가 뭘 하고 즐겼는지 알려 줘야지.

ds:385:698:Dialogue Text.source: Mabel must have really been giving it to him.
ds:385:698:Dialogue Text.target: 메이블이 정말 제대로 해 줬나 봐.

ds:385:699:Dialogue Text.source: She can be quite resourceful with her body, y’know!
ds:385:699:Dialogue Text.target: 그 애는 자기 몸을 아주 요령 있게 쓰거든!

ds:385:701:Dialogue Text.source: And golly, what a mess! Bucky was stunned there, just gushing load after load on her face.
ds:385:701:Dialogue Text.target: 세상에, 정말 흥건했어! 버키는 멍하니 그 애 얼굴에 계속 쏟아 내고 있었지.

ds:385:704:Dialogue Text.source: Now Mabel can definitely stretch! But that toy wasn’t small by any means.
ds:385:704:Dialogue Text.target: 메이블은 확실히 잘 늘어나지! 하지만 그 장난감은 절대 작은 게 아니었어.

ds:385:706:Dialogue Text.source: That’s right, I remember it took a bit of coaxing to get the tip in.
ds:385:706:Dialogue Text.target: 맞아. 끝을 넣으려면 살살 달래야 했던 게 기억나.

ds:385:708:Dialogue Text.source: But as I say! With enough lube, anything will fit!
ds:385:708:Dialogue Text.target: 하지만 내가 늘 말하잖아! 윤활제만 충분하면 뭐든 들어가!

ds:385:710:Dialogue Text.source: I gotta say love, I’ll never get tired of watching you prepare a lady…
ds:385:710:Dialogue Text.target: 여보, 당신이 여자를 준비시켜 주는 걸 보는 건 절대 안 질릴 것 같아…

ds:385:712:Dialogue Text.source: I do know my way around the ladies! And Mabel’s such a delight! And a lil’ horn dog, gosh!
ds:385:712:Dialogue Text.target: 내가 여자 다루는 법은 잘 알지! 메이블은 정말 사랑스럽고! 게다가 엄청 밝히는 애야, 세상에!

ds:385:713:Dialogue Text.source: Once we were able to slide the tip in and out pretty easily, she wanted to go a bit deeper…
ds:385:713:Dialogue Text.target: 끝부분을 꽤 쉽게 넣었다 뺐다 할 수 있게 되니까, 좀 더 깊이 넣고 싶어 하더라고…

ds:385:715:Dialogue Text.source: Now, that toy has some girth to it. It really widens at the center of the shaft. She was loving it!
ds:385:715:Dialogue Text.target: 그 장난감은 꽤 굵어. 특히 자루 한가운데가 확 넓어지지. 메이블은 아주 좋아했어!

ds:385:716:Dialogue Text.source: At that point she was just in pure bliss. You could hear it in her squeaks and moans!
ds:385:716:Dialogue Text.target: 그때는 완전히 황홀경에 빠졌지. 찍찍거리는 소리랑 신음만 들어도 알 수 있었어!

ds:385:717:Dialogue Text.source: Every time she orgasms, there’s this lil twitch in her leg. Keep an eye out for it, it’s super cute!
ds:385:717:Dialogue Text.target: 절정에 이를 때마다 다리가 살짝 떨려. 잘 봐 둬. 정말 귀여워!

ds:385:719:Dialogue Text.source: You were really working her, love. Quite a sight really!
ds:385:719:Dialogue Text.target: 당신이 아주 제대로 해 줬지, 여보. 정말 볼만했어!

ds:385:720:Dialogue Text.source: And I’ve used that toy a few times myself, I knew exactly what Mabel was feeling!
ds:385:720:Dialogue Text.target: 나도 그 장난감을 몇 번 써 봐서, 메이블이 무슨 느낌인지 정확히 알았지!

ds:385:722:Dialogue Text.source: Ah that’s right, you couldn’t hold it in, huh?

ds:385:723:Dialogue Text.source: You came all over her and we JUST cleaned her up!
ds:385:723:Dialogue Text.target: 방금 닦아 줬는데 메이블한테 온통 싸 버렸잖아!

ds:385:725:Dialogue Text.source: Says the girl who uses half a cup of lube…
ds:385:725:Dialogue Text.target: 윤활제를 반 컵이나 쓰는 사람이 할 말이야…

ds:385:728:Dialogue Text.source: Turns out they were doing a whole lot more than cuddling!
ds:385:728:Dialogue Text.target: 알고 보니 껴안기만 하는 게 아니더라!

ds:385:729:Dialogue Text.source: Augustus was giving her a good ole finger blasting!
ds:385:729:Dialogue Text.target: 아우구스투스가 손가락으로 신나게 해 주고 있었어!

ds:385:730:Dialogue Text.source: Mmm, I bet those scales felt great! They are especially smooth on his hands and arms…
ds:385:730:Dialogue Text.target: 으음, 그 비늘이 정말 기분 좋았겠지! 손이랑 팔은 특히 매끈하거든…

ds:385:731:Dialogue Text.source: And speaking of arms, Augustus got to squeezing his entire hand up there.
ds:385:731:Dialogue Text.target: 팔 얘기가 나와서 말인데, 아우구스투스가 손을 통째로 안에 밀어 넣더라.

ds:385:734:Dialogue Text.source: Now, I’ve stuffed some pretty big things in Penny, but this was crazy!
ds:385:734:Dialogue Text.target: 나도 페니 안에 꽤 큰 걸 넣어 봤지만, 이건 정말 대단했어!

ds:385:735:Dialogue Text.source: You can always tell Penny is enjoying it, she lets out these lil’ coos. What a cutie!
ds:385:735:Dialogue Text.target: 페니가 즐기는 건 항상 알 수 있어. 작게 구구거리거든. 정말 귀엽지!
