ds:510:938:Dialogue Text.target:
안녕, 페니! 숲속의 늑대에 대해
아는 게 있는지
물어보려고?

ds:510:939:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Ah! I have crossed paths with him once or twice… <pause>But he seems to keep to himself.
ds:510:939:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]아! 한두 번 마주친 적은 있어… <pause>하지만 혼자 지내는 것 같더라.

ds:510:940:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]I always give him a friendly smile and wave though! <pause>I figured he must be shy.
ds:510:940:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]그래도 난 늘 웃으면서 손을 흔들어 줘! <pause>수줍은 친구인가 보다 했지.

ds:510:942:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]<slow>Y'know...</slow> <pause>I do see all kinds of stuff when flying about...

ds:510:943:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=10]I don’t get in too close of course, folks deserve their privacy after all!
ds:510:943:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=10]물론 너무 가까이 가진 않아. 다들 사생활은 지켜 줘야지!

ds:510:944:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]But these eyes are QUITE astute… <pause>So I can get a pretty good idea what’s going on far down below…
ds:510:944:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]하지만 이 눈은 아주 예리하거든… <pause>저 아래에서 벌어지는 일도 꽤 잘 알 수 있어…

ds:510:945:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Many times now, I've seen that wolf mounting <slow>somethiiing...</slow>
ds:510:945:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]그 늑대가 <slow>무언가에...</slow> 올라탄 걸 여러 번 봤어.

ds:510:948:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]But I can never tell who’s on the receiving end! So I wouldn’t know who to steer you toward…
ds:510:948:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]하지만 받는 상대가 누군지는 도무지 모르겠어! 그러니 누구한테 가 보라고 해야 할지 모르겠네…

ds:511:937:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Hey Rascal. <pause>Oh and Mabel’s with you too! <pause>Hi there.

ds:511:938:Dialogue Text.source:
Hey Oliver! Do you happen to
know the wolf in the woods?
ds:511:938:Dialogue Text.target:
안녕, 올리버! 혹시 숲속의
늑대를 알아?

ds:511:939:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Oooh, I do not… <pause>I <slow>uh…<slow> <pause>try to stay away from any creepy dark woods…

ds:511:940:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]It’s not too bad! <pause>That’s where I’m from, and your eyes adjust pretty well after a bit.
ds:511:940:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]그렇게 나쁘진 않아! <pause>내 고향인데, 조금 있으면 눈도 잘 적응해.

ds:511:941:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Gosh, I don’t know, <pause>it just feels like I’m always being watched…
ds:511:941:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]세상에, 모르겠어. <pause>그냥 늘 누가 날 지켜보는 느낌이야…

ds:511:942:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]I mean, you’re a pretty big guy! <pause>You very well might be!
ds:511:942:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]뭐, 넌 꽤 크잖아! <pause>정말 보고 있을 수도 있지!

ds:511:944:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]You’re not really selling this that well y’know…

ds:511:945:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Haha, sorry, sorry. <pause>I admit the woods are a different flavor than you’re used too…
ds:511:945:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]하하, 미안, 미안. <pause>숲이 네가 익숙한 곳과는 다른 분위기라는 건 인정해…

ds:511:947:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]I’ll take you through sometime! <pause>I can show you around. <pause>It’ll be fun!
ds:511:947:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]언제 데리고 가 줄게! <pause>구경시켜 줄 수 있어. <pause>재밌을 거야!

ds:511:949:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]But back to your original question, <pause>no, <pause>I don’t know any wolves… <pause>sorry!
ds:511:949:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]하지만 원래 질문으로 돌아가면, <pause>아니야. <pause>난 늑대는 아무도 몰라… <pause>미안해!

ds:511:950:Dialogue Text.source: Not a problem! Thanks for your help!

ds:512:938:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]]Oh, Mabel too! <pause>Are you just bummin’ a ride from this guy?
ds:512:938:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]]아, 메이블도! <pause>이 친구한테 그냥 얻어 타고 다니는 거야?

ds:512:939:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Yep! Giving these paws a rest. <pause>You should try it!
ds:512:939:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]응! 발 좀 쉬게 해 주는 거지. <pause>너도 해 봐!

ds:512:940:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Hah! <pause>Ok, next time Rascal’s shoulder is vacant, I’ll climb aboard!
ds:512:940:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]하! <pause>좋아, 다음에 라스칼 어깨가 비면 나도 올라탈게!

ds:512:941:Dialogue Text.source:
So Dustin, we were wondering
if you know anything about
the wolf in the woods?
ds:512:941:Dialogue Text.target:
그래서, 더스틴. 숲속의 늑대에 대해
뭔가 아는 게 있는지
궁금해서?

ds:512:942:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Oooh… <pause>Yeah I’m not too sure about that bloke…

ds:512:943:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]I had a bit of a run in with him a while ago, he <slow>uh...</slow> <pause>wasn't too friendly!

ds:512:945:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Well, <pause>I mean, <pause>perhaps the circumstance wasn’t in my favor…

ds:512:946:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]See, I was running around, trying to stay limber and what not…

ds:512:947:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]And I <slow>literally</slow> ran into him. <pause>Now, I'm a small lad, so no harm was done, <pause>but it was a bit of a surprise for him!
ds:512:947:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]그러다 <slow>말 그대로</slow> 부딪혔어. <pause>난 작으니까 그 친구가 다치진 않았지만, <pause>그 친구는 좀 놀랐지!

ds:512:948:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Honestly, I’m surprised he didn’t chomp my head off, his whole body reacted so quickly! <pause>If he wanted, I would’ve been a goner!
ds:512:948:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]솔직히 내 머리를 안 물어뜯은 게 신기해. 온몸이 엄청 빨리 반응했거든! <pause>마음만 먹었으면 난 끝이었을걸!

ds:512:950:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Yeah, pretty scary for a lil guy like me.

ds:512:951:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]I apologized and quickly got out of there. <pause>But he did NOT look happy…
ds:512:951:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]사과하고 얼른 빠져나왔지. <pause>하지만 전혀 기분이 좋아 보이지 않았어…

ds:512:953:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]I’ve seen em a good number of times since then. I know his scent so it’s easy to tell when he’s near.
ds:512:953:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]그 뒤로도 꽤 여러 번 봤어. 냄새를 아니까 근처에 오면 쉽게 알 수 있어.

ds:512:954:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Not that he smells bad! <pause>Sometimes he smells like he had a <slow>proper</slow> romp!
ds:512:954:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]냄새가 나쁘다는 건 아냐! <pause>가끔은 <slow>제대로</slow> 한바탕 즐긴 냄새도 나더라!

ds:512:955:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Anyways, whenever I do see him, <pause>he doesn’t seem too happy… <pause>So I steer clear!
ds:512:955:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]아무튼 볼 때마다 <pause>별로 기분 좋아 보이지 않아서… <pause>피해 다녀!

ds:513:944:Dialogue Text.source:
We were wondering if you guys
knew the wolf in the woods?

ds:513:945:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Ooo. <pause><wave>"The Wolf in the Woods."</wave> <pause>Sounds so mystical.

ds:513:946:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]I wonder if we got any nick names?

ds:513:949:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Ok, now I hope we <shake>DON'T</shake> have nicknames.

ds:513:950:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]But to answer your question, <pause>no, we don’t know your ”wolf in the woods”.
ds:513:950:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]하지만 네 질문에 답하자면, <pause>아니, 우린 네 ‘숲속의 늑대’를 몰라.

ds:513:951:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]To clarify, we do know there is a wolf in the woods.
ds:513:951:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]확실히 해 두자면, 숲속에 늑대가 있다는 건 알아.

ds:513:952:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]But yeah, we don’t know em. <pause>Never seen em at any parties, or nothin’!
ds:513:952:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]하지만 그래, 아는 사이는 아니야. <pause>파티 같은 데서도 본 적 없어!

ds:513:956:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Right? <pause>There’s something kind of hot about it…

ds:513:958:Dialogue Text.source:
Hah, ok. So looks like you guys
don’t know anything.
ds:513:958:Dialogue Text.target:
하, 좋아. 그러니까 너희도
아는 게 없는 것 같네.

ds:513:961:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Claire, do you really think you can take a wolf?
ds:513:961:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]클레어, 정말 늑대를 받을 수 있을 것 같아?

ds:513:962:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Heh, if not in door number one, <pause>there’s always door number two!
ds:513:962:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]헤헤, 첫 번째 문이 안 되면 <pause>두 번째 문이 늘 있잖아!

ds:513:963:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=9]But I guess that depends on how long he is…

ds:513:964:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]If he's long <slow>AND</slow> girthy. <pause>Whew, <pause>I'm gonna be in for a challenge!

ds:513:965:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]But hey no pain no gain, right?
ds:513:965:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]그래도 고생 없이 얻는 게 없잖아. 그렇지?

ds:513:966:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Sounds like I’ll be in for quite the show!

ds:513:967:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]But if YOU find out anything, let us know!
ds:513:967:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]하지만 네가 뭘 알아내면 우리한테도 알려 줘!

ds:514:938:Dialogue Text.source:
We wanted to know if you knew
anything about the wolf in the woods?
ds:514:938:Dialogue Text.target:
숲속의 늑대에 대해
아는 게 있는지 궁금해서?

ds:514:939:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Wolf in the woods… <pause>Wolf in the woods…

ds:514:940:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Well, these woods actually stretch on for quite a while. <pause>They circle the entire mountain, and I’ve seen a few wolves in my time…
ds:514:940:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]사실 이 숲은 꽤 멀리 뻗어 있어. <pause>산 전체를 둘러싸고 있지. 나도 살면서 늑대 몇은 봤고…

ds:514:942:Dialogue Text.source: Yeah, just in our woods here.

ds:514:943:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Ah, well then no.<pause> I don’t know about them.

ds:514:946:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Yeah from what we’ve gathered, <pause>he’s really not a fan of meeting new critters…
ds:514:946:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]응, 지금까지 알아낸 바로는 <pause>새로운 친구 만나는 걸 정말 안 좋아해…

ds:514:947:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Ah, well that doesn’t sound like too pleasant of a critter…

ds:514:948:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]But maybe it’s just the timing of the situation. We don’t know them after all.
ds:514:948:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]하지만 그냥 때가 안 좋았던 걸지도 몰라. 어쨌든 우린 그 친구를 모르잖아.

ds:514:949:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]We’ve all had moments where meeting new folks is the last thing we want to do.
ds:514:949:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]누구나 새 사람 만나는 게 제일 싫은 순간도 있는 법이지.

ds:514:951:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Well best of luck! <pause>If there’s two critters who can charm him over, it’s you two!
ds:514:951:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]그럼 행운을 빌게! <pause>마음을 돌릴 수 있는 친구 둘이라면 바로 너희지!

ds:515:937:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Hey Rascal! <pause>Oh and the little Mouse from before!
ds:515:937:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]안녕, 라스칼! <pause>아, 전에 봤던 작은 생쥐도 왔네!

ds:515:940:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]How can I can help you two?

ds:515:941:Dialogue Text.source:
We were wondering if you knew
about the wolf in the woods?
ds:515:941:Dialogue Text.target:
숲속의 늑대에 대해
아는 게 있나 해서?

ds:515:942:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Wolf in the woods? You’ll have to be a bit more specific than that, dear.
ds:515:942:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]숲속의 늑대? 좀 더 구체적으로 말해 줘야겠어, 자기야.

ds:515:944:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]And I’ve ran with a few wolves myself, heh…

ds:515:945:Dialogue Text.source:
A large white fella. Solitary guy.
Hangs out near some ponds in the woods?
ds:515:945:Dialogue Text.target:
덩치 크고 하얀 친구야. 혼자 지내고.
숲속 연못 근처에 있어?

ds:515:946:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Oh yes. I’ve seen this guy a few times. <pause>He tends to keep to himself…
ds:515:946:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]아, 그래. 그 친구는 몇 번 봤어. <pause>혼자 지내는 편이지…

ds:515:951:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Her scent! <pause>I’ve smelled it on the wolf before. <pause>Consistently, <pause>might I add.
ds:515:951:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]냄새지! <pause>그 늑대한테서 맡은 적 있어. <pause>그것도 꾸준히, <pause>말해 두자면.

ds:515:954:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Honestly he gives off kinda weird vibes, so I try to keep my distance… <pause>But he’s ventured up the mountain a few times.
ds:515:954:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]솔직히 분위기가 좀 묘해서 거리를 두려고 해… <pause>그래도 산에 몇 번 올라온 적은 있어.

ds:515:956:Dialogue Text.source: That’s great! Thanks for your help!

ds:516:936:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Hey Rascal! <pause>And little Mabel! <pause>Welcome to our cave!
ds:516:936:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]안녕, 라스칼! <pause>작은 메이블도! <pause>우리 동굴에 온 걸 환영해!

ds:516:938:Dialogue Text.source:
We were wondering if you
knew a wolf from the woods?
ds:516:938:Dialogue Text.target:
혹시 숲속에 사는
늑대를 아는지 궁금해서?

ds:516:939:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Oooh, meeting critters isn’t really my thing you know…
ds:516:939:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]아아, 다른 친구 만나는 건 내 특기가 아닌 거 알잖아…

ds:516:940:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]That’s much more a question for Melody!

ds:516:943:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Yeah, I’ve seen him waiting in the same spot a few times.
ds:516:943:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]응, 같은 자리에서 기다리는 걸 몇 번 봤어.

ds:516:945:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Hmm. <pause>Like as if he's meeting someone? <pause>He's not being sneaky, <pause>he’s not hunting, <pause>just<slow>...</slow> waiting.
ds:516:945:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]음. <pause>누군가 만나는 것처럼? <pause>숨어 다니는 것도 아니고, <pause>사냥도 아니고, <pause>그냥<slow>...</slow> 기다려.

ds:516:946:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]After a while he’ll move on. <pause>Maybe the critter he is waiting for shows up, <pause>I can’t really tell from where I usually am…
ds:516:946:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]한참 있으면 움직여. <pause>기다리던 친구가 나타나는 걸지도 모르지만, <pause>보통 내가 있는 데선 잘 안 보여…

ds:516:947:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]My mind goes crazy wondering what he could be up to though! <pause>Maybe he’s a spy! <pause>Or maybe he’s a detective and he’s staking out a bad guy!
ds:516:947:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]뭘 하는 걸까 상상이 마구 떠올라! <pause>어쩌면 첩자일지도! <pause>아니면 나쁜 녀석을 잠복 수사하는 탐정일지도!

ds:516:948:Dialogue Text.source: Or maybe he’s waiting for a hook up?

ds:516:951:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Anyways that’s all I’ve got. Sorry it’s probably not too useful…
ds:516:951:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]아무튼 아는 건 그게 다야. 별로 도움 안 될 것 같아 미안해…

ds:516:952:Dialogue Text.source: No worries! Thanks for your help!

ds:516:953:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Actually, there’s something else you might be able to do for us…
ds:516:953:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]사실 우릴 도와줄 수 있는 게 하나 더 있을지도…

ds:516:955:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Could we borrow that jar on your shelf?
ds:516:955:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]선반 위에 있는 저 병 빌려도 될까?

ds:516:958:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Honestly you’d be doing me a favor! <pause>Seeing food in the jar just makes me hungry!
ds:516:958:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]솔직히 오히려 고마운걸! <pause>병 속 음식을 보면 배만 고파지거든!

ds:517:1000:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Scarlett and I were just having a go, <pause2>and it’s my turn to clean up.

ds:517:1001:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Don’t forget the sheets dear! <pause>You know I hate crusty sheets!
ds:517:1001:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]시트 잊지 마, 여보! <pause>딱딱하게 굳은 시트 싫어하는 거 알지!

ds:517:953:Dialogue Text.source:
We were wondering if you guys
knew anything about the wolf in the woods?
ds:517:953:Dialogue Text.target:
너희가 숲속의 늑대에 대해
아는 게 있는지 궁금해서?

ds:517:954:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]You’re talking about Fen! <pause>The white wolf, right? <pause>Bit of a loner?

ds:517:956:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]That ole chap and I go way back!

ds:517:957:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]But he’s not your usual critter here… <pause>He’s uh… <pause>Well he’s complicated…
ds:517:957:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]하지만 여기 보통 친구들과는 달라… <pause>어… <pause>그 친구는 복잡해…

ds:517:958:Dialogue Text.source:
Yeah we tried to ask a favor of him
and it didn’t go that well…
ds:517:958:Dialogue Text.target:
응, 부탁을 좀 해 봤는데
잘 안 됐어…

ds:517:960:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]But trust me, <pause>he is all bark and no bite!

ds:517:961:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I wouldn't say that, love, <pause>I've seen him bite a <slow>good</slow> number of times!
ds:517:961:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]꼭 그렇진 않아, 여보. <pause>난 무는 걸 꽤 <slow>여러 번</slow> 봤는데!

ds:517:962:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]You know what I mean though, <pause>it’s mostly a front.
ds:517:962:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]그래도 무슨 뜻인지 알잖아. <pause>대부분 겉으로만 그러는 거야.

ds:517:963:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]It’s true, he’s much more friendly than he lets on.

ds:517:966:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]He used to be a scavenging mate of mine! <pause>Taught me a lot, <pause2>helped me through quite a few scraps actually.
ds:517:966:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]예전에 같이 물건을 주우러 다니던 친구였어! <pause>많이 가르쳐 줬고, <pause2>곤란한 일에서도 꽤 많이 도와줬지.

ds:517:967:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]And I had his back too! <pause>Funny what a small critter can do in some dodgy situations!
ds:517:967:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]나도 그 친구를 지켜 줬어! <pause>위험한 상황에서는 작은 친구가 할 수 있는 일도 놀랍다니까!

ds:517:968:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Now dear, he is a lot more than a scavenging buddy of yours…
ds:517:968:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]여보, 그냥 물건 줍는 친구보다 훨씬 더 가까운 사이잖아…

ds:517:969:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Right, love! <pause>Fen actually helped us explore some of our kinks as well!
ds:517:969:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]맞아, 여보! <pause>사실 펜은 우리 취향 몇 가지를 알아보는 것도 도와줬어!

ds:517:970:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]See, he was the first partner we were "open" with. <pause>He’s got a pretty big thing for sizeplay…
ds:517:970:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]우리 부부가 처음으로 관계를 ‘연’ 상대였지. <pause>사이즈 플레이를 아주 좋아하거든…

ds:517:971:Dialogue Text.source:
[pic=1]A REALLY big thing.
Gosh, and when it swells up?
WHEW!

ds:517:973:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]It's an absolute mess afterward, <pause>he's so damn <breath>“productive.”</breath>

ds:517:974:Dialogue Text.source:
That’s actually what we’re
trying to get a hold of…
ds:517:974:Dialogue Text.target:
사실 우리가 구하려는 게
바로 그거야…

ds:517:977:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Well he’s in no shortage of it, <pause>I can tell ya that much!

ds:517:979:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]<slow>Uhh,</slow> it's a long story. <pause>I'll fill you in later.

ds:517:980:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]For now, do you guys think he might want to get intimate with us?
ds:517:980:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]일단 그 친구가 우리랑 은밀하게 즐기고 싶어 할까?

ds:517:981:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Well he can be pretty dang closed off with new critters…
ds:517:981:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]새로운 친구한테는 꽤 마음을 닫는 편이긴 해…

ds:517:984:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]If you want anything from Fen, <pause>Scarlett could make it happen!
ds:517:984:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]펜에게 바라는 게 있다면 <pause>스칼렛이 이루어 줄 수 있어!

ds:517:985:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Heh, what can I say, <pause>I’m a hit with the boys.

ds:517:986:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]But really, I can probably convince him to be a bit more cordial with you all.
ds:517:986:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]하지만 정말, 너희한테 좀 더 친절하게 대하도록 설득할 수 있을 거야.

ds:517:987:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I know he’s been wanting to open up to more critters recently. <pause>This could be a good opportunity!
ds:517:987:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]요즘 더 많은 친구한테 마음을 열고 싶어 한다는 걸 알아. <pause>좋은 기회가 될 수도 있겠네!

ds:517:996:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]You guys are in good hands with Scarlett!

ds:517:997:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]The chap’ll be eating out of your paws soon enough!

ds:517:999:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Nah, I’m tied down here at the moment.

ds:518:1242:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]*She turns to you with a heartfelt look*

ds:518:1247:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Ok, looks like she wants to get started as soon as possible.

ds:518:1250:Dialogue Text.source: I can just watch if it’s not weird for them.
ds:518:1250:Dialogue Text.target: 다들 이상하게 생각하지만 않으면 구경만 해도 괜찮아.

ds:518:1265:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]I’ve never seen this before! The others are gonna love you!
ds:518:1265:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]이런 건 처음 봐! 다른 친구들도 널 좋아할 거야!

ds:518:1266:Dialogue Text.source: Great! Buuut… if it’s an orgy… and like…

ds:518:1267:Dialogue Text.source: You said you didn’t want your mom and me…
ds:518:1267:Dialogue Text.target: 너희 엄마랑 나는 안 됐으면 좋겠다고…

ds:518:1268:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Oh, no worries! She won’t be there.
ds:518:1268:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]아, 걱정 마! 엄마는 거기 안 있어.

ds:518:1271:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Yeah, it’s our job during these rituals. As Matriarch, she does a lot of chanting and me and a few other mice are there to assist however.
ds:518:1271:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]응, 이런 의식에서 맡은 일이 있어. 엄마는 족장으로서 주문을 많이 외우고, 나랑 다른 생쥐 몇은 옆에서 필요한 걸 돕지.

ds:518:1274:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Don’t worry about me though, I’ve been on the fun side of these a ton.
ds:518:1274:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]그래도 난 걱정 마. 즐기는 쪽에는 잔뜩 참여해 봤어.

ds:518:1278:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Yeah. <pause>The markings these mice have are symbolic. And all of the participants must have these markings.
ds:518:1278:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]응. <pause>생쥐들 몸에 있는 무늬는 상징이야. 참여하는 이들은 모두 이 무늬가 있어야 하지.

ds:518:1279:Dialogue Text.source: Oh! I was going to ask you about those…

ds:518:1280:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Yeah I’ll fill ya in later. We have to get started though, and they will need some time to paint you.
ds:518:1280:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]응, 나중에 얘기해 줄게. 하지만 이제 시작해야 하고, 네 몸에 그리는 데도 시간이 필요해.

ds:518:1281:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I’ll have some mice help you, till then, can you drop off the jar by that stump?
ds:518:1281:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]생쥐 몇이 도와줄 거야. 그전에 병을 저 그루터기 옆에 놓아 줄래?

ds:519:902:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I feel like I’m missing out, <pause>what’s happening?

ds:519:903:Dialogue Text.source: Scarlett’s going to help us meet the Wolf!
ds:519:903:Dialogue Text.target: 스칼렛이 늑대를 만나는 걸 도와줄 거야!

ds:519:905:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Ooooh, Scarlett, <pause>are YOU who I smell on him?

ds:519:909:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Put in a good word for me!

ds:51:131:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]It’s a bit chilly for my tastes.

ds:51:132:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I think I’ll stick to the lake…

ds:51:135:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]It’s a bit chilly for my tastes.

ds:51:136:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I think I’ll stick to the lake…

ds:520:902:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Ya guys aren’t trying to rob me, are ya?

ds:520:903:Dialogue Text.source:
Yep! Give us everything ya got!
Or we’ll sic mabel on ya!
ds:520:903:Dialogue Text.target:
맞아! 가진 거 다 내놔!
안 그러면 메이블을 풀어 버릴 거야!

ds:520:904:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Ok ok! I surrender! <pause>I’ve seen what that lil’ mouse can do!
ds:520:904:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]알았어, 알았어! 항복! <pause>저 작은 생쥐가 뭘 할 수 있는지 봤거든!

ds:520:906:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I’m gonna break the ice for these two with a friend of mine!
ds:520:906:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]내 친구랑 이 둘 사이의 서먹함을 풀어 주려고!

ds:520:907:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]This have to do with that wolf fella?

ds:520:911:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]But that’s for another time, we should get going.
ds:520:911:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]하지만 그 얘긴 다음에 하고, 우린 가 봐야겠네.

ds:521:902:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]How come you get all these babes hanging around you?

ds:521:903:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Hah! <pause>I’m lending these two a hand with meeting a friend.

ds:521:907:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]A bit of a grump, <pause>a bit of a loner, <pause>but a good guy.

ds:521:908:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]We got to get going, but I’ll introduce you sometime!

ds:522:902:Dialogue Text.source:
[pic=11]Do you all want rides?
I'll have to make two trips...

ds:522:904:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I’ll be introducing these two to the wolf.

ds:522:905:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Bahawhaw! <pause>Y’know I had a hunch that you might’ve been who he’s been seeing!
ds:522:905:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]푸하하! <pause>그 친구가 만나는 상대가 너일지도 모른다고 짐작은 했어!

ds:522:907:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Nope! <pause>I just see all sorts of stuff when I’m flying about!

ds:522:908:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]So what’s up, why did you ring me then?
ds:522:908:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]그래서 무슨 일이야? 그럼 왜 종을 울렸어?

ds:522:910:Dialogue Text.source: Oh. Uh… Yeah I’m not sure.

ds:522:914:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]<color=#878375><size=10>Put in a good word for me, Scarlett! I'd like to <wave>give him a ride!</wave> Y'know?</color></size>
ds:522:914:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]<color=#878375><size=10>스칼렛, 내 얘기도 좋게 해 줘! 그 친구 <wave>한번 태워 주고 싶네!</wave> 무슨 말인지 알지?</color></size>

ds:523:1000:Dialogue Text.source: Oh? You must be <wiggle>kiiiiinda small</wiggle> then…

ds:523:1003:Dialogue Text.source: Sounds good, you got yourself a deal!

ds:523:1005:Dialogue Text.source:
Oh I can see it.
I just can’t turn down a challenge!
ds:523:1005:Dialogue Text.target:
보여.
그냥 도전을 거절할 수가 없어서!

ds:523:1006:Dialogue Text.source: So how are we doin’ this?

ds:523:1007:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]You take the reins. <pause>I’ll lay on my back, and you climb on top.
ds:523:1007:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]네가 주도해. <pause>내가 뒤로 누울 테니 네가 위로 올라와.

ds:523:1010:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Looks like we’ll be in for a show!

ds:523:1011:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Indeed! <pause>But let’s keep that jar at the ready!

ds:523:1016:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Yep, I’ll be right here. <pause>Don’t worry, <pause>I won’t let these ruffians hurt you.
ds:523:1016:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]응, 바로 여기 있을게. <pause>걱정 마. <pause>이 악당들이 널 해치게 두지 않을게.

ds:523:1018:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Okay you two, come on over! <pause>He won’t bite!
ds:523:1018:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]좋아, 둘 다 이리 와! <pause>물지 않을 거야!

ds:523:1019:Dialogue Text.source:
We hear you like small critters,
and we happen to like big grumpy wolves.
ds:523:1019:Dialogue Text.target:
작은 친구들을 좋아한다며.
마침 우린 크고 심술궂은 늑대를 좋아해.

ds:523:1023:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Don’t take it personal, kid, <pause>I’m new to this whole “getting along with others” thing.
ds:523:1023:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]너무 마음에 담아 두진 마, 작은 친구. <pause>난 이 ‘남들과 어울리기’라는 게 처음이거든.

ds:523:1024:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]What I’m not new to, <pause>is blowing a load or two over some needy critters…
ds:523:1024:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]하지만 익숙한 건 <pause>원하는 친구들한테 한두 발 쏟아 주는 거지…

ds:523:1025:Dialogue Text.source: Oh? I’m liking this side of Fen!
ds:523:1025:Dialogue Text.target: 어? 펜의 이런 모습은 마음에 드는데!

ds:523:1027:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]I’m starting to see something! <pause>Right between those legs! <pause>Looks like he’s getting in the mood!
ds:523:1027:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]난 뭔가 보이기 시작하는데! <pause>바로 저 다리 사이에! <pause>슬슬 달아오르나 봐!

ds:523:1029:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Just thinkin’ about what I’m gonna do to y’all…
ds:523:1029:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]너희한테 뭘 해 줄지 생각하고 있을 뿐이야…

ds:523:1030:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]That rumbling voice saying something like that? <pause>Gets me wet every time.
ds:523:1030:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]그 울리는 목소리로 그런 말을 하면? <pause>매번 젖는다니까.

ds:523:1032:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]<slow>Yoo-hoo!</slow> <pause>Fen! <pause>I've got some friends I'd like you to meet!

ds:523:1036:Dialogue Text.source: *Scarlett will turn toward you and say*
ds:523:1036:Dialogue Text.target: *Scarlett will turn toward you and say*

ds:523:1038:Dialogue Text.source: *Scarlett will hop off toward the wolf. Camera follows Scarlett*
ds:523:1038:Dialogue Text.target: *Scarlett will hop off toward the wolf. Camera follows Scarlett*

ds:523:1039:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]<color=#878375><size=10>Let's see if we can hear what they're talking about...</color></size>

ds:523:1041:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]You know I don’t like meeting new folks.
ds:523:1041:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]나 새 사람 만나는 거 싫어하는 거 알잖아.

ds:523:1042:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]I know, but these two need your help.
ds:523:1042:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]알아. 하지만 이 둘한테 네 도움이 필요해.

ds:523:1043:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=8]Besides, you’ve been saying you wanna start opening up to more folks again.

ds:524:901:Dialogue Text.source: <slow>Riiight.</slow> <pause>But you’ll take a huge load in your ass, and squirt all over my stomach. <pause>Reaaally classy!

ds:525:1003:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Hah, don’t thank me yet! <pause>I’m gonna bury you in new friends!
ds:525:1003:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]하, 아직 고마워하지 마! <pause>새 친구들 속에 널 파묻어 줄 거니까!

ds:525:963:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Well damn! That was hot as hell!

ds:525:964:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I’ll say! <pause>I absolutely adore watchin’ boys goin’ at it.
ds:525:964:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]내 말이! <pause>남자들끼리 즐기는 걸 보는 건 정말 너무 좋아.

ds:525:965:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Yeah yeah, you all got what you wanted. <pause>Now let me rest!
ds:525:965:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]그래, 그래. 다들 원하는 거 얻었잖아. <pause>이젠 쉬게 해 줘!

gettin’ off that easily!

하지만 그렇게 쉽게

ds:525:969:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]That’s right, We’ll be back! <pause>And I wanna see what that tongue can do besides being grumpy.

ds:525:974:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]<slow>Uhhh...</slow> Long story short, <pause>it’s for an orgy!

ds:525:975:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Sorry, I’d just invite you! <pause>But my people are uh… <pause>kinda terrified of you…
ds:525:975:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]미안해. 그냥 초대하고 싶지만! <pause>우리 사람들은, 어… <pause>널 좀 무서워해서…

ds:525:977:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]And don’t feel bad. <pause>I wouldn’t go anyways.

ds:525:978:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I may be trying to open up, but uh… <pause>Just a couple critters at a time…
ds:525:978:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]마음을 열어 보려고는 하지만, 어… <pause>한 번에 친구 둘 정도만…

ds:525:979:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]For sure! One step at a time!

ds:525:981:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]It was great to see you again.

ds:525:982:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=8]I’ve been so busy the past lil while.

ds:525:983:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]No worries, give my regards to Peter.

ds:525:984:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Of course! <pause>He’s been talking about wanting to get the gang together again for some scavenging!
ds:525:984:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]그럼! <pause>다시 다 같이 모여서 물건 주우러 다니고 싶다고 얘기하더라!

ds:528:863:Dialogue Text.source: Throughout the night, mice swap partners, positions, and fluids.
ds:528:863:Dialogue Text.target: 밤새 생쥐들은 상대와 자세를 바꾸고 체액을 나눈다.

ds:528:908:Dialogue Text.source: The mice lose themselves in a tangle of paws and tails.
ds:528:908:Dialogue Text.target: 생쥐들은 서로의 발과 꼬리에 얽혀 정신없이 빠져든다.

ds:528:909:Dialogue Text.source: And of course, they shower their warrior with just as much love and affection.
ds:528:909:Dialogue Text.target: 물론 그들의 전사에게도 그만큼의 사랑과 애정을 쏟아붓는다.

ds:528:912:Dialogue Text.source: As Rascal places the jar near the stump, two elder female mice approach him, their bodies adorned from head to paw with intricate tattoos. They gesture for Rascal to lie down.
ds:528:912:Dialogue Text.target: 라스칼이 병을 그루터기 근처에 놓자, 머리부터 발끝까지 정교한 문신을 한 나이 든 암컷 생쥐 둘이 다가온다. 둘은 라스칼에게 누우라는 손짓을 한다.

ds:528:914:Dialogue Text.source: One mouse working on Rascal’s thighs trail off, settling between his legs. They explore his sheath and move down to his balls. The mouse strokes them lovingly for just a moment, before one of the elders scolds them.
ds:528:914:Dialogue Text.target: 라스칼의 허벅지에 무늬를 그리던 생쥐 하나가 슬쩍 딴짓을 하며 두 다리 사이에 자리 잡는다. 포피를 살펴보다 불알 쪽으로 내려간다. 잠깐 다정하게 쓰다듬지만, 이내 나이 든 생쥐 하나가 꾸짖는다.

ds:528:916:Dialogue Text.source: When he lowers his head, the mice gently place leaves over his eyes. With his vision obscured, Rascal focuses on the sounds around him. The pitter-patter of tiny paws fills the air, growing louder as more mice join in.
ds:528:916:Dialogue Text.target: 라스칼이 머리를 내리자, 생쥐들이 눈 위에 나뭇잎을 살포시 얹는다. 시야가 가려진 라스칼은 주변 소리에 집중한다. 작은 발들이 타닥거리는 소리가 가득하고, 생쥐들이 더 모여들수록 커진다.

ds:528:918:Dialogue Text.source: As the leaves are lifted from Rascal's eyes, he looks down and sees intricate swirls and shapes perfectly mirrored across his body. Nearby, a few mice beam with pride at their handiwork.
ds:528:918:Dialogue Text.target: 눈을 가린 나뭇잎이 걷히자, 라스칼은 몸을 내려다본다. 정교한 소용돌이와 모양이 온몸에 완벽한 대칭으로 그려져 있다. 근처 생쥐 몇이 솜씨를 자랑스러워하며 환하게 웃는다.

ds:528:920:Dialogue Text.source: A floral aroma pierces Rascal's nostrils as the mice begin grinding something. One of the elders barks out commands, and the air fills with citrus and a trace of mint.
ds:528:920:Dialogue Text.target: 생쥐들이 뭔가를 빻기 시작하자 꽃향기가 라스칼의 코를 찌른다. 나이 든 생쥐 하나가 큰 소리로 지시하자, 감귤 향과 옅은 민트 향이 공기를 채운다.

ds:528:922:Dialogue Text.source: “Thank you!” Rascal says, while one of the mice leads him toward the campfire. More mice gather around, watching intently as the elders take turns tossing various items into the fire.
ds:528:922:Dialogue Text.target: ‘고마워!’ 라스칼이 말한다. 생쥐 하나가 그를 모닥불 쪽으로 이끈다. 생쥐들이 더 모여들어, 나이 든 이들이 번갈아 온갖 물건을 불 속에 던지는 모습을 주의 깊게 지켜본다.

ds:528:924:Dialogue Text.source: Small paws move methodically over Rascal's body, tracing bold strokes and intricate swirls. The mice work in perfect harmony.
ds:528:924:Dialogue Text.target: 작은 발들이 라스칼의 몸 위에서 차근차근 움직이며 굵은 선과 정교한 소용돌이를 그린다. 생쥐들은 완벽한 조화를 이루며 일한다.

ds:528:926:Dialogue Text.source: Across the clearing, the stump housing Mabel glows with a steady rhythm, each pulse casting vibrant light. With every burst of color, the campfire’s flames respond in unison.
ds:528:926:Dialogue Text.target: 공터 건너편, 메이블이 있는 그루터기가 일정한 박자로 빛나며 매번 선명한 빛을 뿜는다. 색이 번쩍일 때마다 모닥불의 불꽃도 함께 반응한다.

ds:528:928:Dialogue Text.source: The elder mice's chants become louder! Pink flames and streaks explode out from the campfire! As this happens, the group of mice pair off and begin kissing.
ds:528:928:Dialogue Text.target: 나이 든 생쥐들의 주문 소리가 커진다! 분홍 불꽃과 빛줄기가 모닥불에서 터져 나온다! 그러자 생쥐들이 짝을 지어 키스하기 시작한다.

ds:528:930:Dialogue Text.source: The flames die down as the ritual comes to an end. Exhausted and dripping mice motion for Rascal to follow them to a nearby creek.
ds:528:930:Dialogue Text.target: 의식이 끝나며 불길이 잦아든다. 지치고 체액이 흐르는 생쥐들이 라스칼에게 근처 개울로 따라오라고 손짓한다.

ds:528:932:Dialogue Text.source: Two mice climb on Rascal and begin exploring his snout. “I’ll just follow their lead” thinks Rascal, as they smooch around his lips. He lightly caresses the mice and brings them in closer.
ds:528:932:Dialogue Text.target: 생쥐 둘이 라스칼 위에 올라와 주둥이를 탐색하기 시작한다. 입술 주변에 뽀뽀하는 둘을 보며 라스칼은 ‘그냥 이끄는 대로 따라가자’고 생각한다. 그는 생쥐들을 가볍게 쓰다듬으며 가까이 끌어당긴다.

ds:528:934:Dialogue Text.source: They wash up and return to the campfire...

ds:528:936:Dialogue Text.source: The three take turns making out and exploring each other. Rascal gets bolder with his tongue, and the mice reflect his energy. And then, the trees alight with a brilliant red. And the ritual begins...
ds:528:936:Dialogue Text.target: 셋은 번갈아 진하게 키스하며 서로를 탐색한다. 라스칼은 더 과감하게 혀를 쓰고, 생쥐들도 그 열기에 응한다. 그러다 나무들이 눈부신 붉은빛으로 빛난다. 그리고 의식이 시작된다...

ds:529:149:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]The Blessing is one of our favorite traditions here in the forest!

ds:529:150:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]It's a big ole celebration we have during the Winter!

ds:529:151:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]For a few weeks, we decorate, give gifts, and share meals!
ds:529:151:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]몇 주 동안 장식하고, 선물도 주고, 함께 밥도 먹어!

ds:529:160:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Oh, and if you’re out and about. Ask Mabel what she got up to last year…

ds:529:161:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]It was a particularly crazy year for her!

ds:529:264:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Penny and Augustus could probably tell you more about the history of The Blessing.
ds:529:264:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]페니랑 아우구스투스가 축복의 역사에 대해 더 얘기해 줄 수 있을 거야.

ds:529:267:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]While you’re out and about, you should ask Mabel what she got up to last year…

ds:530:132:Dialogue Text.source: How is Penny able to carry critters all day?
ds:530:132:Dialogue Text.target: 페니는 어떻게 하루 종일 친구들을 태워 날아다녀?

ds:530:138:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Well ya gotta be if you’re flyin’ around with a big ol’ bell every year!

ds:530:149:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Oh shoot! That’s right, I keep forgetting!

ds:530:150:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]The Blessing is a big ole celebration we have during the Winter!

ds:530:151:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]For a few weeks, we decorate, give gifts, and share meals!
ds:530:151:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]몇 주 동안 장식하고, 선물도 주고, 함께 밥도 먹어!

ds:530:153:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]There’s usually a lot of drinks as well, that’s when the real fun happens…
ds:530:153:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]보통 마실 것도 잔뜩 있고, 그때부터 진짜 재미가 시작되지…

ds:530:155:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]That’s true! Peter and I like to throw a big party every year. It can get pretty wild…
ds:530:155:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]맞아! 피터랑 난 매년 큰 파티를 여는 게 좋아. 꽤 화끈해질 때도 있지…

ds:530:156:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Anywho, on the day of "The Blessing," Penny flies around with this giant bell ALL NIGHT LONG!
ds:530:156:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]아무튼 ‘축복’ 당일엔 페니가 이 거대한 종을 들고 밤새 날아다녀!

ds:530:158:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]You should ask her about it! Augustus too! They could probably tell you more about the history of it all.
ds:530:158:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]페니한테 물어봐! 아우구스투스한테도! 그 역사에 대해 더 얘기해 줄 수 있을 거야.

ds:530:160:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Oh, and if you’re out and about. Ask Mabel what she got up to last year…
ds:530:160:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]아, 돌아다니다가 메이블한테 작년에 뭘 했는지 물어봐…

ds:530:161:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]It was a particularly crazy year for her!

ds:531:149:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Rascal! I just had the strangest dream...

ds:531:150:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=8]A bunch of us critters were all together, in a different time and place. But... that place was also here!
ds:531:150:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=8]우리 친구들 여럿이 다른 시간, 다른 장소에 함께 있었어. 그런데… 그곳도 여기였어!

ds:531:151:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=8]Everyone was busy searching for unusual stuff. We worked together to find it all!
ds:531:151:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=8]모두 특이한 물건들을 찾느라 바빴지. 힘을 합쳐서 전부 찾았어!

ds:531:262:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Hmm, maybe those veggies I ate last night were expired...

ds:532:705:Dialogue Text.source: Do you celebrate The Blessing of the Bells?

ds:532:708:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Do I? Oh it’s one of my favorite times of the year!
ds:532:708:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]하냐고? 일 년 중 제일 좋아하는 때 중 하나야!

ds:532:709:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]The friends, the food, the gifts, what’s not to love?
ds:532:709:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]친구들, 음식, 선물, 싫을 게 어디 있어?

ds:532:710:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I particularly love sending out greeting cards to all the critters!
ds:532:710:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]특히 친구들 모두에게 축하 카드를 보내는 게 좋아!

ds:532:711:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]It’s a great way to stay in touch, but it’s an even better opportunity to look cute in front of the camera!
ds:532:711:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]안부를 나누기에도 좋지만, 카메라 앞에서 귀여운 모습을 뽐낼 더 좋은 기회잖아!

ds:532:714:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]I’d usually do a nice wholesome one for the families…
ds:532:714:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]보통 가족들에겐 훈훈하고 건전한 걸 찍어 주고…

ds:532:715:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]And for the close friends, I’ll send them something spicy!

ds:532:718:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Gah! I wish I could show you the one we did last year… I don’t have any extras around…
ds:532:718:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]아! 작년에 찍은 걸 보여 주고 싶은데… 남는 게 없네…

ds:532:719:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Actually, Penny was the one delivering them, perhaps she has an extra…

ds:532:720:Dialogue Text.source: Worth a shot! I’ll ask her.

ds:532:721:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Spoiler alert, not only did she deliver them, but she starred in it too!
ds:532:721:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]미리 말해 주자면, 배달만 한 게 아니라 같이 찍기도 했어!

ds:532:722:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Imagine that! Personally delivering such a revealing and saucy thing!
ds:532:722:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]상상해 봐! 그렇게 훤히 드러나고 야릇한 걸 직접 배달하다니!

ds:532:723:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]I was quite surprised she wanted to deliver them!

ds:532:724:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]But I also knew it’d be a thrill for her…

ds:532:727:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]We’ve been off and on messing around for the past few years.
ds:532:727:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]지난 몇 년 동안 이따금씩 같이 놀았어.

ds:532:728:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I can tell you about it some other time though. You should really ask her about that greeting card!
ds:532:728:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]그 얘기는 나중에 해 줄게. 페니한테 그 축하 카드 얘기 꼭 물어봐!

ds:533:719:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Penny was the one delivering them, perhaps she has an extra…

ds:533:720:Dialogue Text.source: Worth a shot! I’ll ask her.

ds:533:721:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Spoiler alert, not only did she deliver them, but she starred in it too!
ds:533:721:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]미리 말해 주자면, 배달만 한 게 아니라 같이 찍기도 했어!

ds:533:722:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Imagine that! Personally delivering such a revealing and saucy thing!
ds:533:722:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]상상해 봐! 그렇게 훤히 드러나고 야릇한 걸 직접 배달하다니!

ds:533:723:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]I was quite surprised she wanted to deliver them!

ds:533:724:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]But I also knew it’d be a thrill for her…

ds:533:727:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]We’ve been off and on messing around for the past few years.
ds:533:727:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]지난 몇 년 동안 이따금씩 같이 놀았어.

ds:533:728:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I can tell you about it some other time though. You should really ask her about that greeting card!
ds:533:728:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]그 얘기는 나중에 해 줄게. 페니한테 그 축하 카드 얘기 꼭 물어봐!

ds:533:730:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]You know those greeting cards I made for critters during The Blessing?
ds:533:730:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]축복 때 친구들에게 보내려고 만든 축하 카드 알지?

ds:533:732:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]You should really ask Penny about that greeting card!
ds:533:732:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]페니한테 그 축하 카드 얘기 꼭 물어봐!

ds:534:728:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Well we aren’t finished with our renovations just yet, but we did get another area prepared for some fun!
ds:534:728:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]아직 개조가 끝나진 않았지만, 재밌게 놀 공간을 또 마련했어!

ds:534:730:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Indeed! We thought it’d be fun to invite you and some of the boys over to give it a test run!
ds:534:730:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]맞아! 너랑 남자 친구들을 초대해서 시험 삼아 써 보면 재밌겠다 싶었지!

ds:534:733:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Dustin and Bucky have been wanting to mess around, so can you let them know?
ds:534:733:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]더스틴이랑 버키도 놀고 싶어 했으니 알려 줄래?

ds:534:734:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Peter and I will finish preparations meanwhile!

ds:534:738:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Go round up the boys! We’ll be getting things prepped here.

ds:535:728:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Well we aren’t finished with our renovations just yet, but we did get another area prepared for some fun!
ds:535:728:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]아직 개조가 끝나진 않았지만, 재밌게 놀 공간을 또 마련했어!

ds:535:730:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Indeed! We thought it’d be fun to invite you and some of the boys over to give it a test run!
ds:535:730:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]맞아! 너랑 남자 친구들을 초대해서 시험 삼아 써 보면 재밌겠다 싶었지!

ds:535:732:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Let us know when you want to have a go!

ds:536:802:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]More like, a ton of elbow grease…

ds:536:803:Dialogue Text.source:
Yeah what have you guys
been cleaning anyways?
ds:536:803:Dialogue Text.target:
그러고 보니 대체
뭘 청소한 거야?

ds:536:804:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=8]Uh… Well. Let’s just say it’s a long story.

ds:536:805:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]We can fill you in some other time.

ds:536:806:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]For now, we’ve got another bench cleared off! So Scarlett and the ladies wanna take it for a spin!
ds:536:806:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]일단 다른 긴 의자도 하나 치워 놨어! 그래서 스칼렛이랑 여자들이 써 보고 싶대!

ds:536:807:Dialogue Text.source: Nice! Who should I round up this time?

ds:536:808:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]I promised Penny and Mabel first dibs!
ds:536:808:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]페니랑 메이블에게 먼저 써 보게 해 주겠다고 약속했어!

ds:536:809:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Once you’ve gotten a hold of them, come back here and we can get started!

ds:536:810:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Oh, by the way. You can find them up north.
ds:536:810:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]아, 참. 북쪽에 가면 만날 수 있어.

ds:536:811:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I think they were meeting up with Charlotte and Melody near the foot of the mountain.
ds:536:811:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]산기슭 근처에서 샬럿이랑 멜로디를 만나기로 했을 거야.

ds:536:813:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Rascal! Just the critter we wanted to see!

ds:536:815:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]So we’ve shifted into overdrive and made even more progress on the basement!
ds:536:815:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]그래서 우린 더 속도를 내서 지하실 정리를 더 많이 해냈어!

ds:536:817:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Nothing that a bit of elbow grease couldn’t solve!

ds:536:818:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Once you’ve gotten a hold of Penny and Mabel, come back here and we can get started!

ds:537:802:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]More like, a ton of elbow grease…

ds:537:803:Dialogue Text.source:
Yeah what have you guys
been cleaning anyways?
ds:537:803:Dialogue Text.target:
그러고 보니 대체
뭘 청소한 거야?

ds:537:804:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=8]Uh… Well. Let’s just say it’s a long story.

ds:537:805:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]We can fill you in some other time.

ds:537:806:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]For now, we’ve got another bench cleared off! So Scarlett and the ladies wanna take it for a spin!
ds:537:806:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]일단 다른 긴 의자도 하나 치워 놨어! 그래서 스칼렛이랑 여자들이 써 보고 싶대!

ds:537:813:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Rascal! Just the critter we wanted to see!

ds:537:815:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]So we’ve shifted into overdrive and made even more progress on the basement!
ds:537:815:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]그래서 우린 더 속도를 내서 지하실 정리를 더 많이 해냈어!

ds:537:817:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Nothing that a bit of elbow grease couldn’t solve!

ds:537:818:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Let us know when you're ready for another go!

ds:538:25:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Mate! How fast do you think I can sprint to that tree and back?
ds:538:25:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]친구! 저 나무까지 뛰어갔다 오면 얼마나 걸릴 것 같아?

ds:538:27:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Aight mate, I need a breather! Let’s talk later.
ds:538:27:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]좋아, 친구. 숨 좀 돌려야겠어! 나중에 얘기하자.

ds:539:819:Dialogue Text.source: The plant coils on itself and coos sweetly.
ds:539:819:Dialogue Text.target: 식물은 몸을 둥글게 말며 다정하게 소리를 낸다.

ds:539:820:Dialogue Text.source: Oh! Uh! Sorry if that hurt, Scarlett said-

ds:539:821:Dialogue Text.source: Vines coil gently around Rascal, guiding him forward.
ds:539:821:Dialogue Text.target: 덩굴들이 라스칼을 부드럽게 감싸 앞으로 이끈다.

ds:539:822:Dialogue Text.source: Oooh self lubricating… Let’s give this a spin…
ds:539:822:Dialogue Text.target: 오오, 스스로 촉촉해지네… 한번 해 볼까…

ds:539:823:Dialogue Text.source: Rascal grabs the stump, and guides his member to the opening.
ds:539:823:Dialogue Text.target: 라스칼은 그루터기를 잡고 구멍으로 자지를 이끈다.

ds:539:824:Dialogue Text.source: Oh it’s warm! Mmm… Yeah… I can get used to this…
ds:539:824:Dialogue Text.target: 오, 따뜻해! 으음… 응… 이거 익숙해지겠는걸…

ds:539:826:Dialogue Text.source: As Rascal plows away at the stump, the plant begins to drool from every orifice.
ds:539:826:Dialogue Text.target: 라스칼이 그루터기에 거듭 박아 대자 식물의 모든 구멍에서 침이 흐르기 시작한다.

ds:539:827:Dialogue Text.source: The coos and churrs of the plant grow louder, the vines and petals quiver and tremble.
ds:539:827:Dialogue Text.target: 식물의 울음과 골골거림이 커지고, 덩굴과 꽃잎이 바르르 떨린다.

ds:539:828:Dialogue Text.source: Nnnf… D-damn… I’m really about to… cum in a plant…
ds:539:828:Dialogue Text.target: 으읍… 제, 젠장… 정말… 식물 안에 싸겠어…

ds:539:830:Dialogue Text.source: Rascal lets out a small whimper as he goes in with a final thrust. The plant greedily milks load after load.
ds:539:830:Dialogue Text.target: 라스칼은 마지막으로 깊이 밀어 넣으며 작게 낑낑댄다. 식물은 탐욕스럽게 몇 번이고 좆물을 짜낸다.

ds:539:831:Dialogue Text.source: Rascal opens his eyes to see the panting plant gazing at him. It seems to want something.
ds:539:831:Dialogue Text.target: 라스칼이 눈을 뜨자 헐떡이는 식물이 그를 바라보고 있다. 뭔가 바라는 듯하다.

ds:539:833:Dialogue Text.source: The plant gestures a vine toward Rascal’s bits, then rubs one of its oozing vines on the stump.
ds:539:833:Dialogue Text.target: 식물은 덩굴로 라스칼의 아랫도리를 가리킨 다음, 진액이 흐르는 덩굴 하나를 그루터기에 문지른다.

ds:539:834:Dialogue Text.source: Like… You want me to pull out…

ds:539:835:Dialogue Text.source: The plant bobs its head, its tongue flopping about.

ds:539:837:Dialogue Text.source: The plant’s head nods so furiously, saliva goes flying in every direction.
ds:539:837:Dialogue Text.target: 식물이 어찌나 세게 고개를 끄덕이는지 사방으로 침이 튄다.

ds:539:840:Dialogue Text.source: As Rascal pulls out, the plant’s ooze runs down his legs and pools at his paws.
ds:539:840:Dialogue Text.target: 라스칼이 빼내자 식물의 진액이 다리를 타고 흘러 발 아래 고인다.

ds:539:841:Dialogue Text.source: The plant chirps at the sight as Rascal fires off a few loads.
ds:539:841:Dialogue Text.target: 라스칼이 몇 차례 좆물을 뿜어내자 식물은 그 모습을 보고 재잘거리듯 운다.

ds:539:842:Dialogue Text.source: You sure like a show, huh?

ds:539:843:Dialogue Text.source: The plant lays back with a pleased look. Its vines soften and relax. A low purr rumbles from inside the stump.
ds:539:843:Dialogue Text.target: 식물이 만족스러운 표정으로 뒤로 눕는다. 덩굴은 힘을 풀고 느슨해진다. 그루터기 안에서 낮은 골골거림이 울린다.

ds:539:848:Dialogue Text.source: Okay… Well… I’m gonna get cleaned up.

ds:539:849:Dialogue Text.source: The plant leans back and puts a twig in its mouth. The vines gesture to almost "shoo" Rascal away.
ds:539:849:Dialogue Text.target: 식물은 뒤로 기대어 입에 잔가지를 문다. 덩굴로 라스칼을 거의 ‘쫓아내는’ 듯한 손짓을 한다.

ds:539:850:Dialogue Text.source: O-oh! R-right, yeah! Uh! I had a great time! C-Call me!
ds:539:850:Dialogue Text.target: 아, 아! 그, 그래, 응! 어! 정말 좋았어! 여, 연락해!

ds:539:851:Dialogue Text.source: The plant lazily nods its head and pushes Rascal away from the stump.
ds:539:851:Dialogue Text.target: 식물이 느긋하게 고개를 끄덕이고 라스칼을 그루터기에서 밀어낸다.

ds:539:862:Dialogue Text.source: At the center of the stump, a new receptacle awaits, pulsing softly as it oozes a honey-like substance.
ds:539:862:Dialogue Text.target: 그루터기 한가운데 새로 생긴 구멍이 기다리고 있다. 부드럽게 맥동하며 꿀 같은 물질을 흘린다.

ds:539:863:Dialogue Text.source: The plant quivers with eager anticipation…

ds:539:864:Dialogue Text.source: The thick sticky fluid oozes out as he glides further in…
ds:539:864:Dialogue Text.target: 더 깊이 미끄러져 들어가자 걸쭉하고 끈적한 액체가 흘러나온다…

ds:539:865:Dialogue Text.source: As Rascal utters those last words, the plant spasms and throws its head back.
ds:539:865:Dialogue Text.target: 라스칼이 그 말을 끝내자 식물이 경련하며 머리를 뒤로 젖힌다.

ds:539:866:Dialogue Text.source: Fluids gush from the nearby vines. The plant whines in bliss and ecstasy.
ds:539:866:Dialogue Text.target: 근처 덩굴에서 액체가 쏟아진다. 식물은 행복과 황홀경에 겨워 낑낑댄다.

ds:540:232:Dialogue Text.source: [A particularly large flower. It’s… moving… Is it asleep?]
ds:540:232:Dialogue Text.target: [유난히 큰 꽃이다. 이거… 움직이는데… 자는 건가?]

ds:541:131:Dialogue Text.source: Adventures are unavailable during one of your active quests! Better try again later.
ds:541:131:Dialogue Text.target: 진행 중인 퀘스트 때문에 모험을 할 수 없습니다! 나중에 다시 시도해 보세요.

ds:542:416:Dialogue Text.source:
[pic=4]Hey so… You remember
when ya asked me
if I was seeing anyone?
ds:542:416:Dialogue Text.target:
[pic=4]있잖아… 전에
만나는 사람 있냐고
물어봤던 거 기억해?

ds:542:418:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]There's someone else... But it's kind of a long story... Let me know when you have some time and I can tell you about it...
ds:542:418:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]다른 친구도 있어… 그런데 얘기가 좀 길어… 시간 나면 말해 줘. 얘기해 줄게…

ds:543:753:Dialogue Text.source:
[pic=3]Ya know the photoshoot we did?
With Melody?

ds:543:755:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Well before you arrived, we were doing a fashion-oriented shoot.
ds:543:755:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]네가 오기 전엔 패션 중심으로 촬영하고 있었어.

ds:543:756:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]She’d throw on different outfits, and I’d snap some photos.

ds:543:757:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Of course…<pause> she was showing off a lot more than her clothes…
ds:543:757:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]물론…<pause> 옷보다 훨씬 더 많은 걸 보여 줬지만…

ds:543:760:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]But during the shoot, I had placed some of the photos on the counter tops here…
ds:543:760:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]그런데 촬영 중에 사진 몇 장을 여기 계산대 위에 뒀거든…

ds:543:761:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]And I think some of them flew out the window during the storm!
ds:543:761:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]폭풍 때 창밖으로 날아간 게 있는 것 같아!

ds:543:764:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Do you think you can keep an eye out for them?

ds:543:766:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]<bounce>Great!</bounce> If you find them all, let me know!

ds:543:767:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I think I’m missing 9 photos in total.

ds:543:768:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Oh and<slow>, uh, </slow>my dong is in a few of them... <pause><slow>So...</slow> <pause>Enjoy.
ds:543:768:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]아, 그리고<slow>, 어, </slow>몇 장엔 내 자지도 나와… <pause><slow>그러니까…</slow> <pause>즐겁게 봐.

ds:544:773:Dialogue Text.source: I think I found all of the photos!

ds:544:776:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Mmm Yep! <pause>That looks like all of them!

ds:544:778:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Actually I asked Melody if she wanted them back, and she said we could have them!
ds:544:778:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]실은 멜로디한테 돌려받고 싶냐고 물었는데, 우리 가져도 된대!

ds:544:781:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Well, <pause>she said once we do our own photoshoot, <pause>she gets to keep those.

ds:544:783:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]You can have the originals since you found em.

ds:544:784:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Just give me a second while I try to snap a picture of them…
ds:544:784:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]내가 이걸 사진으로 찍을 동안 잠깐만 기다려…

ds:554:753:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]That’s good! But you could never be too sure!

ds:554:754:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]I think I’ll stick in here for a bit.

ds:554:755:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Come on in and warm up with us Rascal!

ds:555:755:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Still very new to this, <pause>“meeting critters” thing.
ds:555:755:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]이런 건 아직 처음이라. <pause>‘다른 친구 만나기’라는 거.

ds:556:752:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=8]Peter, dear, we’ve been running low on some things around the kitchen.
ds:556:752:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=8]피터, 여보. 부엌에 떨어져 가는 게 좀 있어.

ds:556:753:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Yeah, I’ve been meaning to go out for a scavenge soon…

ds:557:753:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I gotta make sure the houses here weren’t leaking during that storm…
ds:557:753:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]그 폭풍에 여기 집들이 새지는 않았는지 확인해야겠네…

ds:557:755:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Y’know Rascal, I feel like things have gotten kinda crazy since ya got here!
ds:557:755:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]있지, 라스칼. 자네가 온 뒤로 일이 좀 엄청나진 것 같네!

ds:557:756:Dialogue Text.source: Oh! Well, I guess I’ll leave.

ds:557:757:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Haha no no, good crazy! Good crazy!
ds:557:757:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]하하, 아냐, 아냐. 좋은 쪽으로! 좋은 쪽으로 말이야!

ds:558:751:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=8]I’m so excited with all of this stuff going on!

ds:558:753:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]I sure am! But it’s just a theory for now!

ds:558:754:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I’ll be sure to tell you once I’m certain!

ds:558:756:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I’m a bit busy at the moment!

ds:559:750:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Claire, some of the cloth got wet.

ds:559:751:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]I told you to keep it off the floor.

ds:559:753:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I have to give off the appearance that I’m the put-together one…
ds:559:753:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]내가 더 정돈된 쪽이라는 인상을 줘야 한다고…

ds:55:131:Dialogue Text.source: Hm… Looks like there is something under the rug…
ds:55:131:Dialogue Text.target: 음… 깔개 밑에 뭔가 있는 것 같다…

ds:560:750:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I should try to paint that storm…

ds:560:751:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]There was a pretty cool funnel forming near the lake!
ds:560:751:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]호수 근처에 꽤 멋진 깔때기 구름이 생기고 있었거든!

ds:560:752:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Hmm, so much has been happening recently…

ds:561:750:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]So yeah! Now you’ve met my folks.

ds:561:751:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Hope they aren’t too crazy for ya!

ds:561:754:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]They’re really greatful for all your help!

ds:562:206:Dialogue Text.source: Player is swimming in the lake
ds:562:206:Dialogue Text.target: Player is swimming in the lake

ds:562:210:Dialogue Text.source:
Uh sorta.
You bumped into me a bit ago.
ds:562:210:Dialogue Text.target:
어, 비슷해.
전에 네가 나랑 부딪혔어.

ds:563:19:Dialogue Text.source: **Second Interact** (Available Act 2+, after the log is interacted with once)
ds:563:19:Dialogue Text.target: **Second Interact** (Available Act 2+, after the log is interacted with once)

ds:564:20:Dialogue Text.source: **Third Interaction** (Available Act 3+, after the log is interacted with twice)
ds:564:20:Dialogue Text.target: **Third Interaction** (Available Act 3+, after the log is interacted with twice)

ds:564:21:Dialogue Text.source: The masterpiece’s last piece has nearly been mastered.

ds:565:101:Dialogue Text.source: Uh… I think you should hold onto it.
ds:565:101:Dialogue Text.target: 어… 네가 가지고 있는 게 좋겠어.

ds:565:102:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]YES! I was hoping you were going to say that!

ds:565:108:Dialogue Text.source:
Damn, you have some
really cool dreams!

ds:565:109:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Haha, it’s rare! But when it happens, I run with it!
ds:565:109:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]하하, 드문 일이야! 하지만 그런 꿈을 꾸면 붙잡아야지!

ds:565:110:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]The dream had a few other critters too!

ds:565:114:Dialogue Text.source: Striped tail! Is that a red panda?

ds:565:116:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Pretty sure at least. I didn’t see the face.

ds:565:119:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]There was two more that I saw in my dream.

ds:565:120:Dialogue Text.source: Have ya seen any critters like them?
ds:565:120:Dialogue Text.target: 쟤들 같은 친구를 본 적 있어?

ds:565:68:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]This one came to me in a dream.

ds:565:69:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Once I woke up, I had to scribble it down!

ds:565:71:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Nah nah, I just painted the edges of the canvas. Kinda sick huh?
ds:565:71:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]아냐, 아냐, 캔버스 가장자리를 칠한 것뿐이야. 좀 멋지지?

ds:565:72:Dialogue Text.source:
Absolutely! Do you get a lot
of inspiration from dreams?
ds:565:72:Dialogue Text.target:
그럼! 꿈에서 영감을
많이 얻는 편이야?

ds:565:74:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]But I’ve been having some really vivid dreams recently!

ds:565:79:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]… Huh! Yeah I can see that!

ds:565:81:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I mean, I was just painting triangles.

ds:565:82:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]But I can’t unsee it now that you mention it.

ds:565:88:Dialogue Text.source: Me? No way! I can’t paint!
ds:565:88:Dialogue Text.target: 내가? 말도 안 돼! 난 그림 못 그려!

ds:565:93:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]I mean… The colors are off but…

ds:565:96:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]No, I had to run some errands, and when I came back, this was here.
ds:565:96:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]아니, 볼일 보러 갔다가 돌아오니 여기 있었어.

ds:566:755:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Anything can be done well too, so that makes it even harder…
ds:566:755:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]뭐든 잘 만들 수 있으니 더 어렵고…

ds:566:756:Dialogue Text.source: What about like, sweet, or spicy?

ds:566:759:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]But a lot of the magic happens when you combine them!
ds:566:759:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]하지만 여러 맛을 합칠 때 마법 같은 일이 많이 생겨!

ds:566:760:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Sweet and savory might be my all time favorite.
ds:566:760:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]달고 고소한 조합을 제일 좋아하는 것 같아.

ds:566:761:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Probably why I enjoy baking so much!

ds:567:763:Dialogue Text.source: How does cooking work up here?

ds:567:764:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Uh, like, the difference in baking in higher altitude?
ds:567:764:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]어, 고도가 높으면 굽는 게 어떻게 달라지냐고?

ds:567:765:Dialogue Text.source:
I kinda meant more like…
Isn’t all that made of ice?
ds:567:765:Dialogue Text.target:
내 말은 좀 더…
저거 전부 얼음 아니야?

ds:567:766:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Oh, no it just looks like ice.

ds:567:773:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]It just looks like ice, but it’s all normal cooking stuff!
ds:567:773:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]얼음처럼 보일 뿐이지, 전부 평범한 요리 도구야!

ds:568:775:Dialogue Text.source: Could I help you make something sometime?
ds:568:775:Dialogue Text.target: 언제 뭘 만드는 거 도와줘도 될까?

ds:568:779:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Ok, well the actual cooking/baking part is usually where the high risk is.
ds:568:779:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]좋아. 보통 실제로 익히거나 굽는 부분이 위험이 크거든.

ds:568:780:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]But I can have you on prep!

ds:568:782:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Yeah! Every ingredient usually needs some sort of preparation.

ds:568:783:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]It’s an important step! But not a huge problem if there’s errors.
ds:568:783:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]중요한 단계야! 그래도 실수해도 큰 문제는 없어.

ds:568:784:Dialogue Text.source:
That sounds perfect!
When do we start?

ds:568:785:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Oh! Uh, yeah. I’ll have to get back to you on that.
ds:568:785:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]아! 어, 응. 그건 나중에 알려 줘야겠어.

ds:568:786:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]I’m running a little low on some ingredients at the moment.

ds:569:792:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Honestly, I kinda wished he’d move back in…

ds:569:793:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]But we don’t have a lot of room here…

ds:570:795:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Hmmm! There’s so many to choose from!

ds:570:799:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Hm… <pause>You know, anything can be interesting if it’s written well enough!
ds:570:799:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]음… <pause>있지, 충분히 잘 썼다면 뭐든 흥미로울 수 있어!

ds:570:800:Dialogue Text.source: Could you tell me about one?
ds:570:800:Dialogue Text.target: 한 권 얘기해 줄 수 있어?

ds:570:802:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]But let me think on it! There’s so many to choose from!
ds:570:802:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]하지만 생각 좀 해 볼게! 고를 게 너무 많아!

ds:571:806:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Well can’t I only be a bottom? I don’t have a… a thing…
ds:571:806:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]그런데 난 바텀만 할 수 있는 거 아냐? 그런… 물건이 없잖아…

ds:571:809:Dialogue Text.source: It’s also more of a dynamic thing.
ds:571:809:Dialogue Text.target: 관계에서 어떤 역할을 하느냐는 뜻도 있고.

ds:571:810:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]So it’s not just who is on top, or the bottom?
ds:571:810:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]그럼 그냥 누가 위나 아래에 있느냐가 아냐?

ds:571:811:Dialogue Text.source:
Right, because there are power-bottoms,
who generate the power from…
ds:571:811:Dialogue Text.target:
맞아. 파워 바텀도 있잖아.
그 힘이 나오는 곳은…

ds:571:812:Dialogue Text.source:
Huh, you know…
Labels are supposed to help, but…
ds:571:812:Dialogue Text.target:
허, 있잖아…
명칭은 도움이 되라고 있는 건데…

ds:571:813:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Yeah I think I’m more lost now!

ds:572:815:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Yesssss! I love that time of year!

ds:572:816:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]The snowy nights are a perfect time to cozy up with some hot chocolate and a good book!
ds:572:816:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]눈 오는 밤은 핫초코랑 좋은 책을 들고 포근하게 있기 딱 좋지!

ds:572:819:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Oh, and the holiday is nice too.

ds:572:820:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]The first big social gathering I went to was actually a Blessings party.
ds:572:820:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]사실 내가 처음 간 큰 모임이 축복제 파티였어.

ds:572:824:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]But I’ve started to have more fun going to them over the years!
ds:572:824:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]하지만 해가 갈수록 가는 게 더 즐거워졌어!

ds:572:826:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]And it’s a great excuse to make some tasty treats!

ds:572:827:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Plus we get to hear Melody's lovely singing!
ds:572:827:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]게다가 멜로디의 멋진 노래도 들을 수 있어!

ds:573:755:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]It’s just something I’ve always had fun with since I was a kit.

ds:574:756:Dialogue Text.source: Do you know Claire and Violet?

ds:574:757:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Of course! Those girls and I go way back!

ds:574:760:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I threw a party a while ago that she attended.

ds:574:761:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]There’s usually a lot of critters at my parties, but when you see another canine wearing a hat?
ds:574:761:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]내 파티에는 보통 친구들이 많은데, 모자를 쓴 다른 개과 동물을 보면?

ds:575:764:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Sometimes! But I really like working with other critters!
ds:575:764:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]가끔은! 하지만 다른 친구들과 작업하는 걸 정말 좋아해!

ds:575:765:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]For example, Claire and Violet’s designs are very functional, and designed with the wearer in mind!
ds:575:765:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]예를 들면, 클레어랑 바이올렛의 디자인은 아주 실용적이고 입는 사람을 생각해서 만들어!

ds:575:766:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Or if Finley sketches out a design, it’s usually full of really fun shapes!
ds:575:766:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]핀리가 디자인을 그리면 보통 정말 재밌는 모양이 잔뜩 있고!

ds:575:767:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Charlotte likes incorporating a story in the design.

ds:575:768:Dialogue Text.source:
Huh! There’s more to
clothes than I thought…

ds:576:771:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Yeah! I used to throw a lot of parties.

ds:576:773:Dialogue Text.source: Oh? I figured that wouldn’t be her thing.
ds:576:773:Dialogue Text.target: 어? 샬럿 취향은 아닐 줄 알았는데.

ds:576:775:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]She was an absolute mess, it was adorable.
ds:576:775:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]완전히 어쩔 줄 몰라 했어. 정말 귀여웠지.

ds:576:776:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I ended up being her party buddy, and well, I guess here we are!
ds:576:776:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]내가 그 애 파티 친구가 되어 줬고, 뭐, 그렇게 지금까지 왔네!

ds:577:782:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I guess I’m whatever the situation calls for.

ds:578:785:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Why, yes... I've been known to dabble...
ds:578:785:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]그럼, 하지... 좀 해 본 적은 있지...

ds:578:790:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Hah! Once she’s had a couple drinks, you can’t get her to shut up!
ds:578:790:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]하! 몇 잔 마시면 입을 다물게 할 수가 없어!

ds:579:761:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Not exactly "a first date" sort of topic.

ds:57:1:Dialogue Text.source: Well… You didn’t quite last as long as I hoped…
ds:57:1:Dialogue Text.target: 음… 내가 바랐던 만큼 오래 버티진 못했네…

ds:57:2:Dialogue Text.source: Not that I can blame you. Not a lot of critters last long with me…
ds:57:2:Dialogue Text.target: 네 탓도 아니지. 나랑 하면 오래 버티는 친구가 별로 없거든…

ds:57:306:Dialogue Text.source: Come on in honey. Take a seat on the bed…

ds:57:307:Dialogue Text.source: Ooh, are we doing sex stuff?

ds:57:308:Dialogue Text.source: Haha, yes. How’s that for a proper thank you?
ds:57:308:Dialogue Text.target: 하하, 그래. 제대로 된 보답으로 어때?

ds:57:310:Dialogue Text.source: But I’m probably a bit too big for you…
ds:57:310:Dialogue Text.target: 그런데 네가 받기엔 내가 좀 클 텐데…

ds:57:311:Dialogue Text.source: Hah, Rascal… The critters here will surprise you with what they are capable of.
ds:57:311:Dialogue Text.target: 하, 라스칼… 여기 친구들이 뭘 할 수 있는지 알면 놀랄 거야.

ds:57:312:Dialogue Text.source: That said, I’ll just be doing some mouth stuff.
ds:57:312:Dialogue Text.target: 그렇긴 해도, 난 그냥 입으로 해 줄게.

ds:57:313:Dialogue Text.source: I’ve been wanting to see what ya got going on down there…
ds:57:313:Dialogue Text.target: 네가 저 아래 뭘 갖고 있는지 보고 싶었거든…

ds:57:314:Dialogue Text.source: Oooh, and look how excited you are already…

ds:57:315:Dialogue Text.source: Ah hah… I blame the recent plant activities…
ds:57:315:Dialogue Text.target: 아하… 방금 그 식물하고 논 탓이야…

ds:57:316:Dialogue Text.source: Lay back, let me get a taste…
ds:57:316:Dialogue Text.target: 뒤로 누워. 맛 좀 보게 해 줘…

ds:57:317:Dialogue Text.source: Rascal lays back and lets the eager bunny get to work…
ds:57:317:Dialogue Text.target: 라스칼은 뒤로 누워, 의욕 넘치는 토끼에게 몸을 맡긴다…

ds:57:3:Dialogue Text.source: Though… judging by this knot, I’d guess I have about a half an hour?
ds:57:3:Dialogue Text.target: 그래도… 이 매듭을 보니 한 삼십 분은 있겠는데?

ds:57:4:Dialogue Text.source: Let’s not waste any more time then…

ds:580:764:Dialogue Text.source: Have ya had any critters you were close with?

ds:580:765:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]I consider Scarlett and Peter my closest friends. Family even.
ds:580:765:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]스칼렛이랑 피터가 가장 가까운 친구야. 가족이라고도 생각하지.

ds:580:767:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I had a lot of friends when I was younger.

ds:581:770:Dialogue Text.source: What do ya do day to day?

ds:581:776:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]But uh… <pause>Maybe I’ll keep an eye out for you…

ds:582:777:Dialogue Text.source: Did you see the Glowing Runes?

ds:582:779:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Good, I thought I was going crazy.

ds:583:781:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Most of the time I’m a top.

ds:583:782:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]I’ve bottomed a couple times… It was… Fine.
ds:583:782:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]바텀도 몇 번 해 봤는데… 뭐… 괜찮았어.

ds:583:783:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]But I’d rather be doing the filling.
ds:583:783:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]하지만 난 채워 주는 쪽이 더 좋아.

ds:584:785:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]It’s always a nice time of year.

ds:584:786:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]The winter nights are so still, and the bells ring out far.
ds:584:786:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]겨울밤은 정말 고요하고, 종소리는 멀리 울려 퍼져.

ds:584:788:Dialogue Text.source:
But you haven’t done
a celebration here?
ds:584:788:Dialogue Text.target:
하지만 여기서 축제에
참여해 본 적은 없어?

ds:585:753:Dialogue Text.source: What’s the significance of the body paint?

ds:585:755:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]The Elder mice paint the others before these ceremonies.
ds:585:755:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]의식 전에 나이 든 생쥐들이 다른 이들에게 그려 줘.

ds:585:756:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]It’s supposed to remove the sense of ego, and allows us to become one. Emotionally, and physically.
ds:585:756:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]자아를 잊고 하나가 되게 해 준대. 감정적으로도, 육체적으로도.

ds:585:758:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Yeah! The markings are pretty prominent, and usually stand out against our fur.
ds:585:758:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]응! 무늬가 꽤 선명해서 보통 우리 털에 두드러져 보여.

ds:585:759:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]So in low light, they’re kinda the most prominent thing?
ds:585:759:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]그래서 어두운 데선 무늬가 제일 잘 보이는 거겠지?

ds:585:762:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I can ask and give you a better explanation later.

ds:586:763:Dialogue Text.source: So where did you go during the ceremony?
ds:586:763:Dialogue Text.target: 그러고 보니 의식 중에는 어디 갔어?

ds:586:764:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]While you guys are off having fun, me, my mother, and some of the elders do the actual ritual.
ds:586:764:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]너희가 즐기는 동안 나랑 엄마, 몇몇 어른들은 실제 의식을 치러.

ds:586:766:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Yeah, we are trying to commune with the spirits. You guys basically supply the energy.
ds:586:766:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]응, 정령들과 교감하려는 거지. 너희는 말하자면 기운을 공급하고.

ds:586:768:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Yeah, I don’t really know. Energy isn’t the right word, but it’s about as close as it gets.
ds:586:768:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]응, 나도 잘 모르겠어. 기운이 정확한 말은 아닌데, 가장 비슷해.

ds:586:769:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]But you guys supply the "energy," then our ritual is supposed to commune with whomever.
ds:586:769:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]아무튼 너희가 ‘기운’을 공급하면, 우리가 의식으로 그 누구와든 교감하려는 거야.

ds:586:770:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Not that I’ve ever seen this work.
ds:586:770:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]물론 그게 통하는 건 한 번도 못 봤어.

ds:586:771:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Honestly, I think the whole thing is bogus.

ds:586:772:Dialogue Text.source:
Well, it’s definitely bogus that
you can’t join in on the fun!
ds:586:772:Dialogue Text.target:
네가 같이 못 즐기는 건
확실히 말도 안 되네!

ds:586:774:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]<size=10><color=#878375>At the same time, I’m glad I won’t have to see my mother getting railed.</color></size>
ds:586:774:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]<size=10><color=#878375>한편으론 엄마가 박히는 걸 안 봐도 돼서 다행이지만.</color></size>

ds:587:777:Dialogue Text.source: I think she’s been making advances on me…

ds:587:778:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]<size=18>NOPE! I SAID DON’T TELL ME ABOUT IT!<size=18>

ds:588:780:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Oh yeah you just hold onto them!

ds:588:781:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]They’ll be entertained there for a while, don’t worry.

ds:589:20:Dialogue Text.source: **Third Interaction** (Available Act 3+, after the log is interacted with twice)
ds:589:20:Dialogue Text.target: **Third Interaction** (Available Act 3+, after the log is interacted with twice)

ds:590:294:Dialogue Text.source: In an instant, roots and vines wrap around Rascal, bringing him closer to the stump.
ds:590:294:Dialogue Text.target: 순식간에 뿌리와 덩굴이 라스칼을 감싸 그루터기 가까이 끌어당긴다.

ds:590:295:Dialogue Text.source: W-whoa! Uh? I’m here for the uh… fertilizer?
ds:590:295:Dialogue Text.target: 우, 우와! 어? 난 그… 비료 때문에 왔는데?

ds:590:296:Dialogue Text.source: The plant bobs up and down excitedly. Purple bulbs unravel and reveal a dripping fleshy mass.
ds:590:296:Dialogue Text.target: 식물이 신나게 위아래로 흔들린다. 보랏빛 봉오리가 펼쳐지며 액체가 뚝뚝 떨어지는 살덩이가 드러난다.

ds:590:297:Dialogue Text.source: Ah I see… Let’s uh, go a little easy?
ds:590:297:Dialogue Text.target: 아, 그렇구나… 우리 좀, 살살 할까?

ds:590:298:Dialogue Text.source: The fleshy mass teases Rascal’s rear. Viscous fluids ooze down his cheeks and tail.
ds:590:298:Dialogue Text.target: 살덩이가 라스칼의 뒤를 애태운다. 끈적한 액체가 엉덩이와 꼬리를 타고 흐른다.

ds:590:299:Dialogue Text.source: The tip pushes gently on his rear, slipping inside…
ds:590:299:Dialogue Text.target: 끝부분이 뒤를 부드럽게 누르며 안으로 미끄러져 들어간다…

ds:590:302:Dialogue Text.source: The plant cuddles and coos Rascal as he makes to leave the stump.
ds:590:302:Dialogue Text.target: 라스칼이 그루터기를 떠나려 하자 식물이 그를 감싸 안고 다정하게 소리를 낸다.

ds:590:303:Dialogue Text.source: W-whew~ I could see why Scarlett’s a fan!
ds:590:303:Dialogue Text.target: 후, 후우~ 스칼렛이 왜 좋아하는지 알겠네!

ds:590:304:Dialogue Text.source: O-Okay… So I guess I’M the mode of transportation for this fertilizer…
ds:590:304:Dialogue Text.target: 조, 좋아… 그러니까 이 비료는 내가 운반하는 거구나…

ds:590:305:Dialogue Text.source: I better not make any sudden movements…

ds:590:306:Dialogue Text.source: Rascal steadies himself, fluids running down his legs…
ds:590:306:Dialogue Text.target: 라스칼은 다리로 액체를 흘리며 중심을 잡는다…

ds:591:752:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=8]Peter, dear, we’ve been running low on some things around the kitchen.
ds:591:752:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=8]피터, 여보. 부엌에 떨어져 가는 게 좀 있어.

ds:591:753:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Yeah, I’ve been meaning to go out for a scavenge soon…

ds:592:752:Dialogue Text.source: Lyllith’s a wolf! She’s badass, justice-driven, and full of mom-energy!
ds:592:752:Dialogue Text.target: 릴리스는 늑대야! 멋지고, 정의감 넘치고, 엄마 같은 기운이 가득하지!

ds:592:754:Dialogue Text.source: She’s a sellsword and usually frequents taverns until she finds a job.
ds:592:754:Dialogue Text.target: 용병으로 일하면서, 보통 일거리를 찾을 때까지 술집을 돌아다녀.

ds:592:755:Dialogue Text.source: A Job… Or a partner for the night.

ds:592:756:Dialogue Text.source: One particular night, she learns about a dragon that’s terrorizing a nearby town…
ds:592:756:Dialogue Text.target: 어느 밤, 근처 마을을 공포에 몰아넣는 용에 대해 알게 돼…

ds:592:758:Dialogue Text.source: Now Lyllith has taken on dragons before. They can be a bit spicy, but nothing she can’t handle.
ds:592:758:Dialogue Text.target: 릴리스는 전에도 용들을 상대해 봤어. 좀 까다로울 수는 있어도 감당 못 할 정도는 아니지.

ds:592:760:Dialogue Text.source: But no amount of gear could’ve prepared her for this dragon…
ds:592:760:Dialogue Text.target: 하지만 어떤 장비로도 이 용을 맞을 준비는 할 수 없었어…

ds:592:773:Dialogue Text.source: It was a quiet night. Fresh snow danced around the sky before landing on their cheeks and snouts.
ds:592:773:Dialogue Text.target: 고요한 밤이었다. 갓 내린 눈이 하늘에서 춤추다 그들의 볼과 주둥이에 내려앉았다.

ds:592:775:Dialogue Text.source: Volkyn (that’s the dragon) gives the wolf a pathetic look.
ds:592:775:Dialogue Text.target: 볼킨, 그러니까 그 용이 늑대를 불쌍한 표정으로 바라봤다.

ds:592:776:Dialogue Text.source: "Lyllith… <pause>P-please let me use your cloak… <pause>I’m so c-c-c-cold…"
ds:592:776:Dialogue Text.target: ‘릴리스… <pause>제, 제발 망토 좀 빌려줘… <pause>너, 너, 너무 추워…’

ds:592:777:Dialogue Text.source: Lyllith knows damn well that this weather is nothing for him.
ds:592:777:Dialogue Text.target: 릴리스는 이런 날씨가 그에게는 아무것도 아니라는 걸 잘 알았다.

ds:592:778:Dialogue Text.source: Not to mention her cloak would be like a napkin to a dragon.
ds:592:778:Dialogue Text.target: 게다가 용에게 그녀의 망토는 냅킨이나 다름없었다.

ds:592:780:Dialogue Text.source: Regardless, she humors him and gives him the cloak.
ds:592:780:Dialogue Text.target: 그래도 장난을 받아 주며 망토를 건넸다.

ds:592:781:Dialogue Text.source: This took him off guard, he thought for sure she souldn’t go through with it.
ds:592:781:Dialogue Text.target: 그는 당황했다. 정말로 그렇게 해 주지는 않을 거라고 확신했기 때문이다.

ds:592:782:Dialogue Text.source: But she did, and now he had to figure out how to tie this tiny thing around his neck.
ds:592:782:Dialogue Text.target: 하지만 그녀는 건넸고, 그는 이제 그 작은 것을 목에 어떻게 묶을지 생각해야 했다.

ds:592:784:Dialogue Text.source: And despite it being a joke at first…

ds:592:785:Dialogue Text.source: It’s the little gestures that really get to him.
ds:592:785:Dialogue Text.target: 그런 작은 행동들이야말로 정말 그의 마음을 움직였다.

ds:592:802:Dialogue Text.source: Volkyn’s muzzle met hers. Lyllith’s mouth was ajar, panting. He took that as an invitation.
ds:592:802:Dialogue Text.target: 볼킨의 주둥이가 그녀의 주둥이와 맞닿았다. 릴리스는 입을 살짝 벌린 채 숨을 헐떡이고 있었다. 그는 그걸 초대로 받아들였다.

ds:592:803:Dialogue Text.source: They locked their lips together, passionately kissing and exploring each other.
ds:592:803:Dialogue Text.target: 둘은 입술을 맞물리고 열정적으로 키스하며 서로를 탐색했다.

ds:592:804:Dialogue Text.source: The wolf was overwelmed with the beast. Between making out and pleasured moans, she was gasping for breath.
ds:592:804:Dialogue Text.target: 늑대는 그 거대한 존재에 압도됐다. 진한 키스와 쾌감 어린 신음 사이사이로 숨을 몰아쉬었다.

ds:592:805:Dialogue Text.source: Lyllith wrapped her legs around Volkyn’s arm. Bringing him closer, demanding him. Her hips lightly thrusting.
ds:592:805:Dialogue Text.target: 릴리스는 두 다리로 볼킨의 팔을 감쌌다. 그를 가까이 끌어당기며 갈구했다. 엉덩이는 가볍게 움직였다.

ds:592:806:Dialogue Text.source: She shuddered in waves of pleasure, as she squeezed his fingers tightly.
ds:592:806:Dialogue Text.target: 그의 손가락을 꽉 조이며, 밀려오는 쾌감에 몸을 떨었다.

ds:592:809:Dialogue Text.source: Volkyn lifted his claw, her juices running down his arm. "Huh… Quite a mess…"
ds:592:809:Dialogue Text.target: 볼킨이 손을 들어 올리자 그녀의 애액이 그의 팔을 타고 흘렀다. ‘허… 꽤 흥건하네…’

ds:592:810:Dialogue Text.source: "Shut up, I’ll clean it." But he had begun lapping at his claws.
ds:592:810:Dialogue Text.target: ‘닥쳐. 내가 닦을게.’ 하지만 그는 이미 손가락을 핥기 시작했다.

ds:592:811:Dialogue Text.source: "Mmm…" A glimmer in his eyes flashed. "You know I’m a vegetarian… But I’d really like to taste you…"
ds:592:811:Dialogue Text.target: ‘으음…’ 그의 눈에 빛이 반짝였다. ‘나 채식주의자인 거 알지… 하지만 네 맛이 정말 보고 싶어…’

ds:592:812:Dialogue Text.source: "Straight from the tap, huh? Alright, go to town."
ds:592:812:Dialogue Text.target: ‘나오는 곳에서 직접 맛보려고? 좋아, 마음껏 해.’

ds:592:813:Dialogue Text.source: The dragon licked his lips and began making his way down her chest.
ds:592:813:Dialogue Text.target: 용은 입술을 핥고 그녀의 가슴 아래로 내려가기 시작했다.

ds:592:814:Dialogue Text.source: His breath was warm. His nostrils flared as he was taking in her every scent.
ds:592:814:Dialogue Text.target: 숨결은 따뜻했다. 그녀의 온갖 냄새를 들이마시며 콧구멍이 벌름거렸다.
